```typescript
<p-toast />
<p-confirmDialog />

<section class="page">
  @if (!seleccionado()) {
  <header class="page-header">
    <div>
      <h3 class="page-title">Consulta de Compras</h3>
      <p class="page-subtitle">Órdenes de compra y facturas de proveedores</p>
    </div>
    <p-button label="Nueva Compra" icon="pi pi-plus" size="small" rounded (onClick)="nuevoMae()" />
  </header>

  <p-table [value]="compras()" [loading]="cargando()" dataKey="compraId" [paginator]="true" [rows]="10"
    [showCurrentPageReport]="true" currentPageReportTemplate="Mostrando {first} a {last} de {totalRecords}"
    [rowsPerPageOptions]="[10, 25, 50]" size="small">
    <ng-template pTemplate="header">
      <tr>
        <th style="width:4rem">#</th>
        <th>Fecha</th>
        <th>Proveedor</th>
        <th>Bodega</th>
        <th>Ref.</th>
        <th style="width:7rem" class="text-right">Total</th>
        <th style="width:6rem">Tipo</th>
        <th style="width:6rem">Pagada</th>
        <th style="width:6rem">Estado</th>
        <th style="width:8rem">Acciones</th>
      </tr>
    </ng-template>
    <ng-template pTemplate="body" let-row>
      <tr (click)="seleccionar(row)" style="cursor:pointer">
        <td>{{ row.compraId }}</td>
        <td>{{ row.fecharegistro | date:'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm' }}</td>
        <td>{{ nombreProveedor(row.proveedorId) }}</td>
        <td>{{ nombreBodega(row.bodegaId) }}</td>
        <td>{{ row.nroreferencia || '-' }}</td>
        <td class="text-right font-bold">{{ moneda(row.total) }}</td>
        <td>
          <p-tag [value]="row.TipoCompra === 'F' ? 'Fiscal' : 'Otra'"
            [severity]="row.TipoCompra === 'F' ? 'info' : 'warn'" [style]="{'font-size':'0.75rem'}" />
        </td>
        <td>
          <p-tag [value]="row.sn_pagada === 'S' ? 'Sí' : 'No'" [severity]="row.sn_pagada === 'S' ? 'success' : 'warn'"
            [style]="{'font-size':'0.75rem'}" />
        </td>
        <td>
          <p-tag [value]="row.sn_anulada === 'S' ? 'Anulada' : 'Activa'"
            [severity]="row.sn_anulada === 'S' ? 'danger' : 'success'" [style]="{'font-size':'0.75rem'}" />
        </td>
        <td>
          <p-button icon="pi pi-trash" severity="danger" text size="small" rounded
            (onClick)="$event.stopPropagation(); anularCompra(row)" [disabled]="row.sn_anulada === 'S'" />
        </td>
      </tr>
    </ng-template>
    <ng-template pTemplate="emptymessage">
      <tr>
        <td colspan="10" class="text-center p-3">No hay compras registradas.</td>
      </tr>
    </ng-template>
  </p-table>
  } @else {
  <header class="page-header">
    <div class="flex align-items-center gap-2">
      <p-button icon="pi pi-arrow-left" text size="small" rounded (onClick)="volver()" />
      <div>
        <h3 class="page-title">Compra #{{ seleccionado()!.compraId }}</h3>
        <p class="page-subtitle">
          {{ nombreProveedor(seleccionado()!.proveedorId) }}
          — {{ nombreBodega(seleccionado()!.bodegaId) }}
          — {{ seleccionado()!.TipoCompra === 'F' ? 'Fiscal' : 'Otra' }}
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="flex gap-2">
      <p-button label="Agregar Item" icon="pi pi-plus" size="small" rounded (onClick)="nuevoDet()"
        [disabled]="seleccionado()!.sn_anulada === 'S'" />
      <p-button label="Procesar" icon="pi pi-check-circle" size="small" rounded severity="success" (onClick)="procesar()"
        [disabled]="detalles().length === 0 || seleccionado()!.sn_anulada === 'S'" />
      <p-button label="Anular" icon="pi pi-times-circle" size="small" rounded severity="danger"
        (onClick)="anularCompra(seleccionado()!)" [disabled]="seleccionado()!.sn_anulada === 'S'" />
    </div>
  </header>

  <p-table [value]="detalles()" [loading]="cargandoDet()" dataKey="cxpcomprasdetId" [paginator]="true" [rows]="15"
    size="small">
    <ng-template pTemplate="header">
      <tr>
        <th style="width:3rem">#</th>
        <th style="width:8rem">Cod. Barra</th>
        <th>Producto</th>
        <th style="width:7rem" class="text-right">Cantidad</th>
        <th style="width:7rem" class="text-right">Precio U.</th>
        <th style="width:7rem" class="text-right">Subtotal</th>
        <th style="width:7rem">Acciones</th>
      </tr>
    </ng-template>
    <ng-template pTemplate="body" let-row>
      <tr>
        <td>{{ row.nrofila }}</td>
        <td>{{ row.codbarra }}</td>
        <td>{{ row.descripcion || nombreProducto(row.productoId) }}</td>
        <td class="text-right font-bold">{{ row.cantidad }}</td>
        <td class="text-right">{{ moneda(row.precio) }}</td>
        <td class="text-right font-bold">{{ moneda(row.subtotal) }}</td>
        <td>
          <p-button icon="pi pi-trash" text severity="danger" size="small" rounded (onClick)="eliminarDet(row)"
            [disabled]="seleccionado()!.sn_anulada === 'S'" />
        </td>
      </tr>
    </ng-template>
    <ng-template pTemplate="emptymessage">
      <tr>
        <td colspan="7" class="text-center p-3">No hay items en esta compra.</td>
      </tr>
    </ng-template>
  </p-table>

  <div class="compra-totales">
    <div class="total-line">
      <span>Total Compra:</span>
      <span class="font-bold">{{ moneda(seleccionado()!.total) }}</span>
    </div>
    <div class="total-line">
      <span>Estado Pago:</span>
      <p-tag [value]="seleccionado()!.sn_pagada === 'S' ? 'Pagada' : 'Pendiente'"
        [severity]="seleccionado()!.sn_pagada === 'S' ? 'success' : 'warn'" [style]="{'font-size':'0.75rem'}" />
    </div>
  </div>
  }
</section>

<!-- Dialog Nueva Compra -->
<p-dialog header="Nueva Compra" [modal]="true" [draggable]="false" [resizable]="false" [breakpoints]="{ '960px': '75vw', '640px': '90vw' }" [style]="{width:'550px', minHeight:'350px'}"
  [(visible)]="dialogMae">
  <form [formGroup]="formMae" class="flex flex-column gap-3">
    <div class="form-grid-2">
      <div>
        <label class="block mb-1 text-sm font-medium">Proveedor *</label>
        <p-select formControlName="proveedorId" [options]="proveedores()" optionLabel="nombres"
          optionValue="proveedorId" placeholder="Seleccionar proveedor" [filter]="true"
          [filterBy]="'nombres,apellidos,razonsocial'" styleClass="w-full" [appendTo]="'body'">
          <ng-template let-prov pTemplate="item">
            <span>{{ prov.nombres }} {{ prov.apellidos }}</span>
          </ng-template>
        </p-select>
      </div>
      <div>
        <label class="block mb-1 text-sm font-medium">Bodega *</label>
        <p-select formControlName="bodegaId" [options]="bodegas()" optionLabel="descripcion" optionValue="bodegaId"
          placeholder="Seleccionar bodega" styleClass="w-full" [appendTo]="'body'" />
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="form-grid-2">
      <div>
        <label class="block mb-1 text-sm font-medium">Tipo de Compra *</label>
        <p-select formControlName="TipoCompra"
          [options]="[{label:'Factura Fiscal', value:'F'},{label:'Otro Documento', value:'O'}]" optionLabel="label"
          optionValue="value" styleClass="w-full" [appendTo]="'body'" />
      </div>
      <div>
        <label class="block mb-1 text-sm font-medium">Documento Fiscal</label>
        <p-select formControlName="documentoId" [options]="documentosFiscales()" optionLabel="label" optionValue="value"
          placeholder="Seleccionar documento" styleClass="w-full" [showClear]="true" [appendTo]="'body'" />
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="form-grid-2">
      <div>
        <label class="block mb-1 text-sm font-medium">Moneda *</label>
        <p-select formControlName="monedaId" [options]="monedas()" optionLabel="label" optionValue="value"
          placeholder="Seleccionar moneda" styleClass="w-full" [appendTo]="'body'" />
      </div>
      <div>
        <label class="block mb-1 text-sm font-medium">Nro. Referencia</label>
        <input pInputText formControlName="nroreferencia" class="w-full"
          placeholder="Nro. factura o referencia del proveedor" />
      </div>
    </div>
  </form>
  <ng-template pTemplate="footer">
    <p-button label="Cancelar" severity="secondary" text size="small" rounded (onClick)="dialogMae.set(false)" />
    <p-button label="Crear Compra" icon="pi pi-check" size="small" rounded severity="success" [raised]="true" (onClick)="guardarMae()" [disabled]="formMae.invalid" />
  </ng-template>
</p-dialog>

<!-- Dialog Agregar Item -->
<p-dialog header="Agregar Producto" [modal]="true" [draggable]="false" [resizable]="false" [breakpoints]="{ '960px': '75vw', '640px': '90vw' }" [style]="{width:'500px', minHeight:'350px'}"
  [(visible)]="dialogDet">
  <form [formGroup]="formDet" class="flex flex-column gap-3">
    <div>
      <label class="block mb-1 text-sm font-medium">Producto *</label>
      <p-select formControlName="productoId" [options]="productos()" optionLabel="descripcion" optionValue="produtoId"
        placeholder="Buscar producto..." [filter]="true" [filterBy]="'descripcion,codbarra'" styleClass="w-full"
        [showClear]="true" [appendTo]="'body'">
        <ng-template let-prod pTemplate="item">
          <div class="flex flex-column">
            <span class="text-sm font-medium">{{ prod.descripcion }}</span>
            <span class="text-xs text-color-secondary">{{ prod.codbarra }} — L {{ prod.cstounit | number:'1.2-2'
              }}</span>
          </div>
        </ng-template>
      </p-select>
    </div>
    <div class="form-grid-2">
      <div>
        <label class="block mb-1 text-sm font-medium">Cantidad *</label>
        <p-inputNumber formControlName="cantidad" [min]="0.01" mode="decimal" [minFractionDigits]="2"
          [maxFractionDigits]="2" size="small" [inputStyle]="{ 'width': '100%' }" styleClass="w-full" />
      </div>
      <div>
        <label class="block mb-1 text-sm font-medium">Precio Unitario *</label>
        <p-inputNumber formControlName="precio" [min]="0.01" mode="currency" currency="HNL" [locale]="'es-HN'"
          [minFractionDigits]="2" [maxFractionDigits]="2" [useGrouping]="true" size="small"
          [inputStyle]="{ 'width': '100%' }" styleClass="w-full" />
      </div>
    </div>
  </form>
  <ng-template pTemplate="footer">
    <p-button label="Cancelar" severity="secondary" text size="small" rounded (onClick)="dialogDet.set(false)" />
    <p-button label="Agregar" icon="pi pi-check" size="small" rounded severity="success" [raised]="true" (onClick)="guardarDet()" [disabled]="formDet.invalid" />
  </ng-template>
</p-dialog>
```

## 📄 src\app\features\inventario\consulta-compras\consulta-compras.ts

```typescript
import { Component, inject, signal, OnInit, DestroyRef, ChangeDetectionStrategy } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule, ReactiveFormsModule, FormBuilder, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { takeUntilDestroyed } from '@angular/core/rxjs-interop';
import { TableModule } from 'primeng/table';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';
import { InputNumberModule } from 'primeng/inputnumber';
import { DialogModule } from 'primeng/dialog';
import { TagModule } from 'primeng/tag';
import { ToastModule } from 'primeng/toast';
import { ConfirmDialogModule } from 'primeng/confirmdialog';
import { ToolbarModule } from 'primeng/toolbar';
import { SelectModule } from 'primeng/select';
import { TooltipModule } from 'primeng/tooltip';
import { MessageService, ConfirmationService } from 'primeng/api';
import { CxpService } from '../../../core/services/cxp.service';
import { BodegasService } from '../../../core/services/bodegas.service';
import { ProductosService } from '../../../core/services/productos.service';
import { CatalogoParametrosService } from '../../../core/services/catalogo-parametros.service';
import { AuthService } from '../../../core/services/auth.service';
import { CompraMae, CompraDet, Proveedor, Producto, Bodega } from '../../../core/models/inventario.models';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-consulta-compras',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    CommonModule, FormsModule, ReactiveFormsModule,
    TableModule, ButtonModule, InputTextModule, InputNumberModule,
    DialogModule, TagModule, ToastModule, ConfirmDialogModule,
    ToolbarModule, SelectModule, TooltipModule,
  ],
  templateUrl: './consulta-compras.html',
  styleUrl: './consulta-compras.scss',
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
})
export class ConsultaCompras implements OnInit {
  private fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private service = inject(CxpService);
  private bodegasService = inject(BodegasService);
  private productosService = inject(ProductosService);
  private catalogService = inject(CatalogoParametrosService);
  private auth = inject(AuthService);
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);
  private confirm = inject(ConfirmationService);
  private destroyRef = inject(DestroyRef);
  private router = inject(Router);

  compras = signal<CompraMae[]>([]);
  detalles = signal<CompraDet[]>([]);
  proveedores = signal<Proveedor[]>([]);
  bodegas = signal<Bodega[]>([]);
  productos = signal<Producto[]>([]);
  documentosFiscales = signal<{ label: string; value: number }[]>([]);
  monedas = signal<{ label: string; value: number }[]>([]);

  seleccionado = signal<CompraMae | null>(null);
  cargando = signal(false);
  cargandoDet = signal(false);

  dialogMae = signal(false);
  dialogDet = signal(false);
  esEdicion = signal(false);

  totalFactura = signal(0);

  formMae = this.fb.group({
    proveedorId: [null as number | null, Validators.required],
    bodegaId: [null as number | null, Validators.required],
    TipoCompra: ['F' as 'F' | 'O', Validators.required],
    documentoId: [null as number | null],
    monedaId: [null as number | null, Validators.required],
    nroreferencia: [''],
    subtotal: [0],
    descuento: [0],
    impuesto: [0],
    total: [0],
  });

  formDet = this.fb.group({
    productoId: [null as number | null, Validators.required],
    cantidad: [1, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0.01)]],
    precio: [0, [Validators.required, Validators.min(0.01)]],
  });

  ngOnInit() {
    this.cargarCompras();
    this.cargarProveedores();
    this.cargarBodegas();
    this.cargarProductos();
    this.cargarDocumentosFiscales();
    this.cargarMonedas();
  }

  cargarCompras() {
    this.cargando.set(true);
    this.service.getCompras().pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
      next: (data) => {
        this.compras.set(data || []);
        this.cargando.set(false);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.cargando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: 'No se pudieron cargar las compras' });
      },
    });
  }

  cargarProveedores() {
    this.service.getProveedores().pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
      next: (data) => this.proveedores.set(data || []),
    });
  }

  cargarBodegas() {
    this.bodegasService.getAll().pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
      next: (data: any) => this.bodegas.set(data?.value || data || []),
    });
  }

  cargarProductos() {
    this.productosService.getAll().pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
      next: (data: any) => this.productos.set(data?.value || data || []),
    });
  }

  cargarDocumentosFiscales() {
    this.catalogService.getAll<any>('/parametros/tcotipodocumentofiscal').pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
      next: (res) => {
        const user = this.auth.currentUser();
        const filtered = (res || []).filter((r: any) => {
          const activo = r.sn_activo === 'S';
          const mismaEmpresa = user?.empresaId ? Number(r.empresaId) === Number(user.empresaId) : true;
          return activo && mismaEmpresa;
        });
        this.documentosFiscales.set(filtered.map((r: any) => ({
          label: r.descripcion,
          value: r.tipodocumentofiscalId,
        })));
      },
    });
  }

  cargarMonedas() {
    this.catalogService.getAll<any>('/parametros/monedas').pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
      next: (res) => {
        const user = this.auth.currentUser();
        const filtered = (res || []).filter((r: any) => {
          const mismaEmpresa = user?.empresaId ? Number(r.empresaId) === Number(user.empresaId) : true;
          return mismaEmpresa;
        });
        this.monedas.set(filtered.map((r: any) => ({
          label: r.descripcion,
          value: r.monedaId,
        })));
      },
    });
  }

  seleccionar(compra: CompraMae) {
    this.seleccionado.set(compra);
    this.cargarDetalles(compra.compraId);
  }

  cargarDetalles(compraId: number) {
    this.cargandoDet.set(true);
    this.service.getDetallesByCompra(compraId).pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
      next: (data) => {
        this.detalles.set(data || []);
        this.cargandoDet.set(false);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.cargandoDet.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: 'No se pudieron cargar los detalles' });
      },
    });
  }

  volver() {
    this.seleccionado.set(null);
    this.detalles.set([]);
  }

  nuevoMae() {
    this.router.navigate(['/cxp/compras']);
  }

  guardarMae() {
    if (this.formMae.invalid) return;
    const val = this.formMae.value;
    const payload: any = {
      ...val,
      sn_pagada: 'N',
      sn_anulada: 'N',
    };

    this.service.createCompra(payload).pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
      next: (res: any) => {
        this.msgs.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Guardado', detail: 'Compra creada exitosamente' });
        this.dialogMae.set(false);
        this.cargarCompras();
        if (res?.compraId) {
          this.seleccionar(res);
        }
      },
      error: (err) => {
        const detail = err.error?.message || 'No se pudo crear la compra';
        this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail });
      },
    });
  }

  nuevoDet() {
    this.formDet.reset({ productoId: null, cantidad: 1, precio: 0 });
    this.dialogDet.set(true);
  }

  guardarDet() {
    if (this.formDet.invalid) return;
    const val = this.formDet.value;
    const mae = this.seleccionado();
    if (!mae) return;

    const producto = this.productos().find(p => p.produtoId === val.productoId);
    const payload: any = {
      compraId: mae.compraId,
      bodegaId: mae.bodegaId,
      codbarra: producto?.codbarra || '',
      descripcion: producto?.descripcion || '',
      cantidad: val.cantidad || 1,
      precio: val.precio || 0,
      subtotal: (val.cantidad || 1) * (val.precio || 0),
      empresaId: mae.empresaId,
    };

    this.service.createCompraDet(payload).pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.msgs.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Guardado', detail: 'Item agregado' });
        this.dialogDet.set(false);
        this.cargarDetalles(mae.compraId);
      },
      error: (err) => this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: err.error?.message || 'No se pudo guardar el item' }),
    });
  }

  eliminarDet(row: CompraDet) {
    this.confirm.confirm({
      message: `¿Eliminar item "${row.descripcion || row.codbarra}"?`,
      header: 'Confirmar',
      acceptLabel: 'Eliminar',
      rejectLabel: 'Cancelar',
      accept: () => {
        this.confirm.close();
        this.service.deleteCompraDet(row.cxpcomprasdetId).pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
          next: () => {
            this.msgs.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Eliminado' });
            this.cargarDetalles(this.seleccionado()!.compraId);
          },
          error: (err) => {
            this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: err.error?.message || 'No se pudo eliminar' });
          },
        });
      },
      reject: () => {
        this.confirm.close();
      },
    });
  }

  procesar() {
    const mae = this.seleccionado();
    if (!mae) return;
    this.confirm.confirm({
      message: `¿Procesar compra #${mae.compraId}? Se registrará entrada en kardex y movimiento CxP (débito).`,
      header: 'Procesar compra',
      acceptLabel: 'Procesar',
      rejectLabel: 'Cancelar',
      accept: () => {
        this.confirm.close();
        this.service.procesarCompra(mae.compraId).pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
          next: (res: any) => {
            this.msgs.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Procesada', detail: res?.message || 'Compra procesada' });
            this.cargarCompras();
            this.cargarDetalles(mae.compraId);
          },
          error: (err) => this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: err.error?.message || 'No se pudo procesar' }),
        });
      },
      reject: () => {
        this.confirm.close();
      },
    });
  }

  anularCompra(compra: CompraMae) {
    this.confirm.confirm({
      message: `¿Anular compra #${compra.compraId}? Se reversará el kardex y se marcará el movimiento CxP como anulado.`,
      header: 'Anular compra',
      acceptLabel: 'Anular',
      rejectLabel: 'Cancelar',
      accept: () => {
        this.confirm.close();
        this.service.anularCompra(compra.compraId).pipe(takeUntilDestroyed(this.destroyRef)).subscribe({
          next: (res: any) => {
            this.msgs.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Anulada', detail: res?.message || 'Compra anulada' });
            this.cargarCompras();
            if (this.seleccionado()?.compraId === compra.compraId) {
              this.volver();
            }
          },
          error: (err) => this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: err.error?.message || 'No se pudo anular' }),
        });
      },
      reject: () => {
        this.confirm.close();
      },
    });
  }

  nombreProveedor(id: number): string {
    const p = this.proveedores().find(x => x.proveedorId === id);
    return p ? `${p.nombres} ${p.apellidos}` : `Proveedor #${id}`;
  }

  nombreBodega(id: number): string {
    return this.bodegas().find(b => b.bodegaId === id)?.descripcion || `Bodega ${id}`;
  }

  nombreProducto(id: number): string {
    return this.productos().find(p => p.produtoId === id)?.descripcion || `Producto #${id}`;
  }

  moneda(val: number): string {
    if (val == null || isNaN(val)) return 'L 0.00';
    return val.toLocaleString('es-HN', { style: 'currency', currency: 'HNL' });
  }

  actualizarTotales() {
    const sub = this.detalles().reduce((sum, d) => sum + (d.subtotal || 0), 0);
    this.totalFactura.set(sub);
  }
}

```

## 📄 src\app\features\inventario\embalajes\embalaje-form.html

```typescript
<section class="page">
  <header class="page-header">
    <div>
      <h1 class="page-title">{{ titulo() }}</h1>
      <p class="page-subtitle">Registro de embalaje</p>
    </div>
    <p-button
      label="Volver"
      icon="pi pi-arrow-left"
      severity="secondary"
      text
      size="small"
      rounded
      (onClick)="volver()"
    />
  </header>

  @if (cargando()) {
    <div class="card">Cargando datos...</div>
  } @else {
    <form [formGroup]="form" (ngSubmit)="guardar()" class="card form-grid">
      <div class="campo">
        <label for="descripcion">Descripción <span class="req">*</span></label>
        <input
          pInputText
          id="descripcion"
          formControlName="descripcion"
          maxlength="50"
          placeholder="Nombre del embalaje"
          [ngClass]="{ 'ng-invalid': invalid('descripcion') }"
        />
        @if (invalid('descripcion')) {
          <small class="err">La descripción es obligatoria</small>
        }
      </div>

      @if (esEdicion()) {
        <div class="campo">
          <label>Estado <span class="req">*</span></label>
          <p-select size="small"
            [options]="snOptions"
            formControlName="sn_activo"
            optionLabel="label"
            optionValue="value"
            placeholder="Estado"
            styleClass="w-full"
            [appendTo]="'body'"
          />
        </div>
      }

      <div class="acciones-form">
        <p-button
          type="button"
          label="Cancelar"
          icon="pi pi-times"
          severity="secondary"
          size="small"
          rounded
          (onClick)="volver()"
        />
        <p-button type="submit" label="Guardar" icon="pi pi-check" rounded size="small" [loading]="guardando()" />
      </div>
    </form>
  }
</section>
```

## 📄 src\app\features\inventario\embalajes\embalaje-form.ts

```typescript
import { Component, inject, signal, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { ReactiveFormsModule, FormBuilder, FormGroup, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';
import { SelectModule } from 'primeng/select';
import { MessageService } from 'primeng/api';
import { EmbalajesService } from '../../../core/services/embalajes.service';
import { AuthService } from '../../../core/services/auth.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-embalaje-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, ReactiveFormsModule, ButtonModule, InputTextModule, SelectModule],
  templateUrl: './embalaje-form.html',
  styleUrl: './embalaje-form.scss',
})
export class EmbalajeForm implements OnInit {
  private fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private router = inject(Router);
  private service = inject(EmbalajesService);
  private auth = inject(AuthService);
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);

  esEdicion = signal(false);
  cargando = signal(false);
  guardando = signal(false);
  titulo = signal('Nuevo embalaje');

  readonly snOptions = [
    { label: 'Activo', value: 'S' },
    { label: 'Inactivo', value: 'N' },
  ];

  private embalajeId = 0;

  form!: FormGroup;

  ngOnInit() {
    this.form = this.fb.group({
      descripcion: ['', Validators.required],
      sn_activo: ['S' as 'S' | 'N'],
    });

    const id = this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id');
    if (id) {
      this.esEdicion.set(true);
      this.titulo.set('Editar embalaje');
      this.embalajeId = Number(id);
      this.cargando.set(true);
      this.service.getOne(this.embalajeId).subscribe({
        next: (c) => {
          this.form.patchValue({
            descripcion: c.descripcion,
            sn_activo: c.sn_activo === 'S' ? 'S' : 'N',
          });
          this.cargando.set(false);
        },
        error: () => {
          this.cargando.set(false);
          this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: 'Embalaje no encontrado' });
          this.volver();
        },
      });
    }
  }

  invalid(ctrl: string): boolean {
    const c = this.form.get(ctrl);
    return !!c && c.invalid && (c.dirty || c.touched);
  }

  volver() {
    this.router.navigate(['../'], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  guardar() {
    if (this.form.invalid) {
      this.form.markAllAsTouched();
      return;
    }

    const raw = this.form.getRawValue();
    const payload = this.esEdicion()
      ? { descripcion: raw.descripcion, sn_activo: raw.sn_activo }
      : { descripcion: raw.descripcion, empresaId: this.auth.currentUser()?.empresaId, sn_activo: 'S' };

    this.guardando.set(true);
    const op = this.esEdicion()
      ? this.service.update(this.embalajeId, payload as any)
      : this.service.create(payload as any);

    op.subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.guardando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({
          severity: 'success',
          summary: 'Guardado',
          detail: this.esEdicion() ? 'Embalaje actualizado' : 'Embalaje creado correctamente',
        });
        this.volver();
      },
      error: () => {
        this.guardando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({
          severity: 'error',
          summary: 'Error',
          detail: 'No se pudo guardar el embalaje',
        });
      },
    });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { Component, inject, signal, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router, ActivatedRoute } from '@angular/router';
import { DataViewModule } from 'primeng/dataview';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';
import { TagModule } from 'primeng/tag';
import { TooltipModule } from 'primeng/tooltip';
import { MessageService } from 'primeng/api';
import { EmbalajesService } from '../../../core/services/embalajes.service';
import { Embalaje } from '../../../core/models/inventario.models';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-embalajes',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    CommonModule,
    FormsModule,
    DataViewModule,
    ButtonModule,
    InputTextModule,
    TagModule,
    TooltipModule,
  ],
  templateUrl: './embalajes.html',
  styleUrl: './embalajes.scss',
})
export class Embalajes implements OnInit {
  private service = inject(EmbalajesService);
  private router = inject(Router);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);

  data = signal<Embalaje[]>([]);
  filtered = signal<Embalaje[]>([]);
  cargando = signal(false);

  q = signal('');

  ngOnInit() {
    this.load();
  }

  load() {
    this.cargando.set(true);
    this.service.getAll().subscribe({
      next: (res) => {
        this.data.set(res);
        this.filtrar();
        this.cargando.set(false);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.cargando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({
          severity: 'error',
          summary: 'Error',
          detail: 'No se pudieron cargar los embalajes',
        });
      },
    });
  }

  filtrar() {
    const q = this.q().toLowerCase();
    this.filtered.set(
      this.data().filter((c) => !q || c.descripcion.toLowerCase().includes(q)),
    );
  }

  buscar() {
    this.filtrar();
  }

  limpiarFiltros() {
    this.q.set('');
    this.filtrar();
  }

  nuevo() {
    this.router.navigate(['nuevo'], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  editar(id?: number, e?: Event) {
    e?.stopPropagation();
    if (!id) return;
    this.router.navigate(['editar', id], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  activoLbl(sn: string): string {
    return sn === 'S' ? 'Activo' : 'Inactivo';
  }

  activoSev(sn: string): 'success' | 'danger' {
    return sn === 'S' ? 'success' : 'danger';
  }
}
```

## 📄 src\app\features\inventario\existencias\existencias.ts

```typescript
import { Component, inject, signal, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { TableModule } from 'primeng/table';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';
import { TagModule } from 'primeng/tag';
import { MessageService } from 'primeng/api';
import { ExistenciasService } from '../../../core/services/existencias.service';
import { BodegasService } from '../../../core/services/bodegas.service';
import { ApiService } from '../../../core/services/api.service';
import { forkJoin } from 'rxjs';

export interface ProductoExistencia {
  productoId: number;
  codbarra: string;
  descripcion: string;
  precioventa: number;
  imagen: string | null;
  disponibilidad: 'Alta' | 'Baja';
  bodegas: { bodegaId: number; descripcion: string; existencia: number }[];
}

@Component({
  selector: 'app-existencias',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule, TableModule, ButtonModule, InputTextModule, TagModule],
  templateUrl: './existencias.html',
  styleUrl: './existencias.scss',
})
export class Existencias implements OnInit {
  private service = inject(ExistenciasService);
  private bodegasService = inject(BodegasService);
  private api = inject(ApiService);
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);

  data = signal<ProductoExistencia[]>([]);
  filtered = signal<ProductoExistencia[]>([]);
  cargando = signal(false);
  q = signal('');
  expandedRows = signal<Record<number, boolean>>({});

  // Zoom imagen
  zoomVisible = signal(false);
  zoomUrl = signal('');
  zoomX = signal(0);
  zoomY = signal(0);

  ngOnInit() {
    this.load();
  }

  load() {
    this.cargando.set(true);
    forkJoin([
      this.service.getAll(),
      this.api.get<any[]>('/inventario/tienda/productos'),
      this.bodegasService.getAll(),
    ]).subscribe({
      next: ([existencias, productos, bodegas]) => {
        const mapa = new Map<number, ProductoExistencia>();

        for (const e of existencias) {
          if (!mapa.has(e.productoId)) {
            const prod = productos.find((p: any) => p.produtoId === e.productoId);
            mapa.set(e.productoId, {
              productoId: e.productoId,
              codbarra: prod?.codbarra || '',
              descripcion: prod?.descripcion || '',
              precioventa: Number(prod?.precioventa) || 0,
              imagen: prod?.imagen || null,
              disponibilidad: 'Baja',
              bodegas: [],
            });
          }

          const bodega = bodegas.find((b: any) => b.bodegaId === e.bodegaId);
          const entry = mapa.get(e.productoId)!;
          entry.bodegas.push({
            bodegaId: e.bodegaId,
            descripcion: bodega?.descripcion || `Bodega ${e.bodegaId}`,
            existencia: Number(e.existencia) || 0,
          });
        }

        const totalExistencia = (p: ProductoExistencia) =>
          p.bodegas.reduce((sum, b) => sum + b.existencia, 0);

        for (const entry of mapa.values()) {
          entry.disponibilidad = totalExistencia(entry) >= 50 ? 'Alta' : 'Baja';
        }

        const resultado = Array.from(mapa.values());
        this.data.set(resultado);
        this.filtrar();
        this.cargando.set(false);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.cargando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({
          severity: 'error',
          summary: 'Error',
          detail: 'No se pudieron cargar los datos',
        });
      },
    });
  }

  filtrar() {
    const q = this.q().toLowerCase();
    this.filtered.set(
      this.data().filter((e) => {
        if (!q) return true;
        return (
          e.codbarra?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          e.descripcion?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          e.bodegas.some((b) => b.descripcion?.toLowerCase().includes(q))
        );
      }),
    );
  }

  buscar() {
    this.filtrar();
  }

  limpiarFiltros() {
    this.q.set('');
    this.filtrar();
  }

  toggleRow(rowData: ProductoExistencia) {
    const key = rowData.productoId;
    const current = { ...this.expandedRows() };
    if (current[key]) {
      delete current[key];
    } else {
      current[key] = true;
    }
    this.expandedRows.set(current);
  }

  totalExistencia(p: ProductoExistencia): number {
    return p.bodegas.reduce((sum, b) => sum + b.existencia, 0);
  }

  resolverImagen(imagen: string | null): string {
    if (!imagen) return '';
    return /^data:/i.test(imagen) ? imagen : `data:image/png;base64,${imagen}`;
  }

  getItemImagen(item: ProductoExistencia): string {
    if (item.imagen) return this.resolverImagen(item.imagen);
    return '';
  }

  onImgHover(url: string, event: MouseEvent) {
    this.zoomUrl.set(url);
    this.zoomX.set(event.clientX + 12);
    this.zoomY.set(event.clientY - 100);
    this.zoomVisible.set(true);
  }

  onImgMove(event: MouseEvent) {
    this.zoomX.set(event.clientX + 12);
    this.zoomY.set(event.clientY - 100);
  }

  onImgLeave() {
    this.zoomVisible.set(false);
  }

  moneda(n: number | undefined): string {
    return (n ?? 0).toLocaleString('es-HN', {
      style: 'currency',
      currency: 'HNL',
    });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { Routes } from '@angular/router';
import { CatalogoConfig } from './catalogo-list/catalogo-list';

export const INVENTARIO_ROUTES: Routes = [
  { path: '', redirectTo: 'productos', pathMatch: 'full' },

  // Productos
  { path: 'productos', loadComponent: () => import('./productos/productos').then(m => m.Productos) },
  { path: 'productos/nuevo', loadComponent: () => import('./productos/producto-form').then(m => m.ProductoForm) },
  { path: 'productos/editar/:id', loadComponent: () => import('./productos/producto-form').then(m => m.ProductoForm) },

  // Categorías
  { path: 'categorias', data: { catalogo: { titulo: 'Categorías', subtitulo: 'Administración de categorías de productos', ruta: '/inventario/categorias', idKey: 'categoriaId', icono: 'pi-tags', tituloNuevo: 'Nueva categoría', campos: [{ key: 'descripcion', label: 'Descripción' }] } satisfies CatalogoConfig }, loadComponent: () => import('./catalogo-list/catalogo-list').then(m => m.CatalogoList) },
  { path: 'categorias/nuevo', data: { nombre: 'categorias' }, loadComponent: () => import('../parametros/catalogo-generico/catalogo-form').then(m => m.CatalogoForm) },
  { path: 'categorias/editar/:id', data: { nombre: 'categorias' }, loadComponent: () => import('../parametros/catalogo-generico/catalogo-form').then(m => m.CatalogoForm) },

  // Marcas
  { path: 'marcas', data: { catalogo: { titulo: 'Marcas', subtitulo: 'Administración de marcas', ruta: '/inventario/marcas', idKey: 'marcaId', icono: 'pi-bookmark', tituloNuevo: 'Nueva marca', campos: [{ key: 'descripcion', label: 'Descripción' }] } satisfies CatalogoConfig }, loadComponent: () => import('./catalogo-list/catalogo-list').then(m => m.CatalogoList) },
  { path: 'marcas/nuevo', data: { nombre: 'marcas' }, loadComponent: () => import('../parametros/catalogo-generico/catalogo-form').then(m => m.CatalogoForm) },
  { path: 'marcas/editar/:id', data: { nombre: 'marcas' }, loadComponent: () => import('../parametros/catalogo-generico/catalogo-form').then(m => m.CatalogoForm) },

  // Modelos
```

## 📄 src\app\features\inventario\kardex\kardex.ts

```typescript
import { Component, inject, signal, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { TableModule } from 'primeng/table';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';
import { TagModule } from 'primeng/tag';
import { MessageService } from 'primeng/api';
import { KardexService } from '../../../core/services/kardex.service';
import { Kardex as KardexMov } from '../../../core/models/inventario.models';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-kardex',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule, TableModule, ButtonModule, InputTextModule, TagModule],
  templateUrl: './kardex.html',
  styleUrl: './kardex.scss',
})
export class Kardex implements OnInit {
  private service = inject(KardexService);
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);

  data = signal<KardexMov[]>([]);
  filtered = signal<KardexMov[]>([]);
  cargando = signal(false);

  q = signal('');

  ngOnInit() {
    this.load();
  }

  load() {
    this.cargando.set(true);
    this.service.getAll().subscribe({
      next: (res) => {
        this.data.set(res);
        this.filtrar();
        this.cargando.set(false);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.cargando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({
          severity: 'error',
          summary: 'Error',
          detail: 'No se pudieron cargar los movimientos de kardex',
        });
      },
    });
  }

  filtrar() {
    const q = this.q().toLowerCase();
    this.filtered.set(
      this.data().filter((k) => {
        if (!q) return true;
        return (
          k.codbarra?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          k.nroreferencia?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          String(k.productoId).includes(q)
        );
      }),
    );
  }

  buscar() {
    this.filtrar();
  }

  limpiarFiltros() {
    this.q.set('');
    this.filtrar();
  }

  moneda(n: number | undefined): string {
    return (n ?? 0).toLocaleString('es-HN', {
      style: 'currency',
      currency: 'HNL',
    });
  }
}
```

## 📄 src\app\features\inventario\marcas\marca-form.ts

```typescript
import { Component, inject, signal, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { ReactiveFormsModule, FormBuilder, FormGroup, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';
import { SelectModule } from 'primeng/select';
import { MessageService } from 'primeng/api';
import { MarcasService } from '../../../core/services/marcas.service';
import { AuthService } from '../../../core/services/auth.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-marca-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, ReactiveFormsModule, ButtonModule, InputTextModule, SelectModule],
  templateUrl: './marca-form.html',
  styleUrl: './marca-form.scss',
})
export class MarcaForm implements OnInit {
  private fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private router = inject(Router);
  private service = inject(MarcasService);
  private auth = inject(AuthService);
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);

  esEdicion = signal(false);
  cargando = signal(false);
  guardando = signal(false);
  titulo = signal('Nueva marca');

  readonly snOptions = [
    { label: 'Activo', value: 'S' },
    { label: 'Inactivo', value: 'N' },
  ];

  private marcaId = 0;

  form!: FormGroup;

  ngOnInit() {
    this.form = this.fb.group({
      descripcion: ['', Validators.required],
      sn_activo: ['S' as 'S' | 'N'],
    });

    const id = this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id');
    if (id) {
      this.esEdicion.set(true);
      this.titulo.set('Editar marca');
      this.marcaId = Number(id);
      this.cargando.set(true);
      this.service.getOne(this.marcaId).subscribe({
        next: (c) => {
          this.form.patchValue({
            descripcion: c.descripcion,
            sn_activo: c.sn_activo === 'S' ? 'S' : 'N',
          });
          this.cargando.set(false);
        },
        error: () => {
          this.cargando.set(false);
          this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: 'Marca no encontrada' });
          this.volver();
        },
      });
    }
  }

  invalid(ctrl: string): boolean {
    const c = this.form.get(ctrl);
    return !!c && c.invalid && (c.dirty || c.touched);
  }

  volver() {
    this.router.navigate(['../'], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  guardar() {
    if (this.form.invalid) {
      this.form.markAllAsTouched();
      return;
    }

    const raw = this.form.getRawValue();
    const payload = this.esEdicion()
      ? { descripcion: raw.descripcion, sn_activo: raw.sn_activo }
      : { descripcion: raw.descripcion, empresaId: this.auth.currentUser()?.empresaId, sn_activo: 'S' };

    this.guardando.set(true);
    const op = this.esEdicion()
      ? this.service.update(this.marcaId, payload as any)
      : this.service.create(payload as any);

    op.subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.guardando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({
          severity: 'success',
          summary: 'Guardado',
          detail: this.esEdicion() ? 'Marca actualizada' : 'Marca creada correctamente',
        });
        this.volver();
      },
      error: () => {
        this.guardando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({
          severity: 'error',
          summary: 'Error',
          detail: 'No se pudo guardar la marca',
        });
      },
    });
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { Component, inject, signal, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router, ActivatedRoute } from '@angular/router';
import { DataViewModule } from 'primeng/dataview';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';
import { TagModule } from 'primeng/tag';
import { TooltipModule } from 'primeng/tooltip';
import { MessageService } from 'primeng/api';
import { MarcasService } from '../../../core/services/marcas.service';
import { Marca } from '../../../core/models/inventario.models';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-marcas',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    CommonModule,
    FormsModule,
    DataViewModule,
    ButtonModule,
    InputTextModule,
    TagModule,
    TooltipModule,
  ],
  templateUrl: './marcas.html',
  styleUrl: './marcas.scss',
})
export class Marcas implements OnInit {
  private service = inject(MarcasService);
  private router = inject(Router);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);

  data = signal<Marca[]>([]);
  filtered = signal<Marca[]>([]);
  cargando = signal(false);

  q = signal('');

  ngOnInit() {
    this.load();
  }

  load() {
    this.cargando.set(true);
    this.service.getAll().subscribe({
      next: (res) => {
        this.data.set(res);
        this.filtrar();
        this.cargando.set(false);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.cargando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({
          severity: 'error',
          summary: 'Error',
          detail: 'No se pudieron cargar las marcas',
        });
      },
    });
  }

  filtrar() {
    const q = this.q().toLowerCase();
    this.filtered.set(
      this.data().filter((c) => !q || c.descripcion.toLowerCase().includes(q)),
    );
  }

  buscar() {
    this.filtrar();
  }

  limpiarFiltros() {
    this.q.set('');
    this.filtrar();
  }

  nuevo() {
    this.router.navigate(['nuevo'], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  editar(id?: number, e?: Event) {
    e?.stopPropagation();
    if (!id) return;
    this.router.navigate(['editar', id], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  activoLbl(sn: string): string {
    return sn === 'S' ? 'Activo' : 'Inactivo';
  }

  activoSev(sn: string): 'success' | 'danger' {
    return sn === 'S' ? 'success' : 'danger';
  }
}
```

## 📄 src\app\features\inventario\modelos\modelo-form.ts

```typescript
import { Component, inject, signal, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { ReactiveFormsModule, FormBuilder, FormGroup, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';
import { SelectModule } from 'primeng/select';
import { MessageService } from 'primeng/api';
import { ModelosService } from '../../../core/services/modelos.service';
import { AuthService } from '../../../core/services/auth.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-modelo-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, ReactiveFormsModule, ButtonModule, InputTextModule, SelectModule],
  templateUrl: './modelo-form.html',
  styleUrl: './modelo-form.scss',
})
export class ModeloForm implements OnInit {
  private fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private router = inject(Router);
  private service = inject(ModelosService);
  private auth = inject(AuthService);
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);

  esEdicion = signal(false);
  cargando = signal(false);
  guardando = signal(false);
  titulo = signal('Nuevo modelo');

  readonly snOptions = [
    { label: 'Activo', value: 'S' },
    { label: 'Inactivo', value: 'N' },
  ];

  private modeloId = 0;

  form!: FormGroup;

  ngOnInit() {
    this.form = this.fb.group({
      descripcion: ['', Validators.required],
      sn_activo: ['S' as 'S' | 'N'],
    });

    const id = this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id');
    if (id) {
      this.esEdicion.set(true);
      this.titulo.set('Editar modelo');
      this.modeloId = Number(id);
      this.cargando.set(true);
      this.service.getOne(this.modeloId).subscribe({
        next: (c) => {
          this.form.patchValue({
            descripcion: c.descripcion,
            sn_activo: c.sn_activo === 'S' ? 'S' : 'N',
          });
          this.cargando.set(false);
        },
        error: () => {
          this.cargando.set(false);
          this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: 'Modelo no encontrado' });
          this.volver();
        },
      });
    }
  }

  invalid(ctrl: string): boolean {
    const c = this.form.get(ctrl);
    return !!c && c.invalid && (c.dirty || c.touched);
  }

  volver() {
    this.router.navigate(['../'], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  guardar() {
    if (this.form.invalid) {
      this.form.markAllAsTouched();
      return;
    }

    const raw = this.form.getRawValue();
    const payload = this.esEdicion()
      ? { descripcion: raw.descripcion, sn_activo: raw.sn_activo }
      : { descripcion: raw.descripcion, empresaId: this.auth.currentUser()?.empresaId, sn_activo: 'S' };

    this.guardando.set(true);
    const op = this.esEdicion()
      ? this.service.update(this.modeloId, payload as any)
      : this.service.create(payload as any);

    op.subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.guardando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({
          severity: 'success',
          summary: 'Guardado',
          detail: this.esEdicion() ? 'Modelo actualizado' : 'Modelo creado correctamente',
        });
        this.volver();
      },
      error: () => {
        this.guardando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({
          severity: 'error',
          summary: 'Error',
          detail: 'No se pudo guardar el modelo',
        });
      },
    });
  }
}
```

```typescript
<section class="page">
  <header class="page-header">
    <div>
      <h1 class="page-title">Modelos</h1>
      <p class="page-subtitle">Administración de modelos de productos</p>
    </div>
    <p-button label="Nuevo modelo" icon="pi pi-plus" rounded size="small" (onClick)="nuevo()" />
  </header>

  <div class="filtros card">
    <div class="campo">
      <label>Buscar</label>
      <input
        pInputText
        type="text"
        placeholder="Descripción..."
        [ngModel]="q()"
        (ngModelChange)="q.set($event)"
        (keyup.enter)="buscar()"
      />
    </div>
    <div class="campo acciones">
      <p-button label="Buscar" icon="pi pi-search" size="small" rounded (onClick)="buscar()" />
      <p-button
        label="Limpiar"
        icon="pi pi-times"
        severity="secondary"
        text
        size="small"
        rounded
        (onClick)="limpiarFiltros()"
      />
    </div>
  </div>

  <p-dataview
    [value]="filtered()"
    [loading]="cargando()"
    dataKey="modeloId"
    [paginator]="true"
    [rows]="20"
    layout="list"
    size="small"
    [rowsPerPageOptions]="[10, 20, 50]"
    [showCurrentPageReport]="true"
    currentPageReportTemplate="Mostrando {first} a {last} de {totalRecords}"
  >
    <ng-template #list let-items>
      <div class="dv-cards">
        @for (c of items; track c.modeloId) {
          <div class="dv-card">
            <div class="dv-top">
              <span class="dv-title">{{ c.descripcion }}</span>
              <p-tag [value]="activoLbl(c.sn_activo)" [severity]="activoSev(c.sn_activo)" />
            </div>

            <div class="dv-body">
              <div class="dv-row">
                <span class="dv-label">ID</span>
                <span class="dv-value">{{ c.modeloId }}</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div class="dv-actions" (click)="$event.stopPropagation()">
              <p-button
                icon="pi pi-pencil"
                pTooltip="Editar"
                (onClick)="editar(c.modeloId, $event)"
                severity="warn"
                text
                size="small"
                rounded
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        }
      </div>
    </ng-template>

    <ng-template #emptymessage>
      <div class="text-center p-3">No hay modelos que coincidan con los filtros.</div>
    </ng-template>
  </p-dataview>
</section>
```

```typescript
        @for (c of items; track c.pasilloId) {
          <div class="dv-card">
            <div class="dv-top">
              <span class="dv-title">{{ c.descripcion }}</span>
              <p-tag [value]="activoLbl(c.sn_activo)" [severity]="activoSev(c.sn_activo)" />
            </div>

            <div class="dv-body">
              <div class="dv-row">
                <span class="dv-label">ID</span>
                <span class="dv-value">{{ c.pasilloId }}</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div class="dv-actions" (click)="$event.stopPropagation()">
              <p-button
                icon="pi pi-pencil"
                pTooltip="Editar"
                (onClick)="editar(c.pasilloId, $event)"
                severity="warn"
                text
                size="small"
                rounded
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        }
      </div>
    </ng-template>

    <ng-template #emptymessage>
      <div class="text-center p-3">No hay pasillos que coincidan con los filtros.</div>
    </ng-template>
  </p-dataview>
</section>
```

## 📄 src\app\features\inventario\pasillos\pasillos.ts

```typescript
import { Component, inject, signal, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router, ActivatedRoute } from '@angular/router';
import { DataViewModule } from 'primeng/dataview';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';
import { TagModule } from 'primeng/tag';
import { TooltipModule } from 'primeng/tooltip';
import { MessageService } from 'primeng/api';
import { PasillosService } from '../../../core/services/pasillos.service';
import { Pasillo } from '../../../core/models/inventario.models';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-pasillos',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    CommonModule,
    FormsModule,
    DataViewModule,
    ButtonModule,
    InputTextModule,
    TagModule,
    TooltipModule,
  ],
  templateUrl: './pasillos.html',
  styleUrl: './pasillos.scss',
})
export class Pasillos implements OnInit {
  private service = inject(PasillosService);
  private router = inject(Router);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);

  data = signal<Pasillo[]>([]);
  filtered = signal<Pasillo[]>([]);
  cargando = signal(false);

  q = signal('');

  ngOnInit() {
    this.load();
  }

  load() {
    this.cargando.set(true);
    this.service.getAll().subscribe({
      next: (res) => {
        this.data.set(res);
        this.filtrar();
        this.cargando.set(false);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.cargando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({
          severity: 'error',
          summary: 'Error',
          detail: 'No se pudieron cargar los pasillos',
        });
      },
    });
  }

  filtrar() {
    const q = this.q().toLowerCase();
    this.filtered.set(
      this.data().filter((c) => !q || c.descripcion.toLowerCase().includes(q)),
    );
  }

  buscar() {
    this.filtrar();
  }

  limpiarFiltros() {
    this.q.set('');
    this.filtrar();
  }

  nuevo() {
    this.router.navigate(['nuevo'], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  editar(id?: number, e?: Event) {
    e?.stopPropagation();
    if (!id) return;
    this.router.navigate(['editar', id], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  activoLbl(sn: string): string {
    return sn === 'S' ? 'Activo' : 'Inactivo';
  }

  activoSev(sn: string): 'success' | 'danger' {
    return sn === 'S' ? 'success' : 'danger';
  }
}
```

```typescript
<section class="page">

                }

              <div class="campo">
                <label for="codbarra">Código de barras</label>
                <input
                  pInputText
                  pSize="small"
                  id="codbarra"
                  formControlName="codbarra"
                  maxlength="20"
                  placeholder="Código de barras"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- Accordion: Costos y Precio de Venta -->
          <p-accordion class="mb-3" [value]="['0']">
            <p-accordion-panel value="0">
              <p-accordion-header>Costos y Precio de Venta</p-accordion-header>
              <p-accordion-content>
                <div class="p-fluid">

                        id="cstoprom"
                        formControlName="cstoprom"
                        mode="currency"
                        currency="HNL"
                        [locale]="'es-HN'"
                        [minFractionDigits]="2"
                        [maxFractionDigits]="2"
                        [useGrouping]="true"
                        [inputStyle]="{ 'width': '100%' }"
                      />
                    </div>

                    <div class="campo">
                      <label for="puntoretorno">Punto de retorno</label>
                      <p-inputnumber size="small"
                        id="puntoretorno"
                        formControlName="puntoretorno"
                        mode="currency"
                        currency="HNL"
                        [locale]="'es-HN'"
                        [minFractionDigits]="2"
                        [maxFractionDigits]="2"
                        [useGrouping]="true"
                        [inputStyle]="{ 'width': '100%' }"
                      />

                    <div class="campo">
                      <label for="precioventa">Precio de venta</label>
                      <p-inputnumber size="small"
                        id="precioventa"

                        currency="HNL"

              </p-accordion-content>
            </p-accordion-panel>

          <!-- Accordion: Categoria, Impuesto, Estado -->
          <p-accordion class="mb-3" [value]="['0']">
            <p-accordion-panel value="0">
              <p-accordion-header>Categoría, Impuesto y Estado</p-accordion-header>
              <p-accordion-content>
                <div class="p-fluid">
                  <div class="form-grid-2">
                    <div class="campo">
                      <label for="categoriaId">Categoría <span class="req">*</span></label>
                      <p-select
                        size="small"
                        id="categoriaId"

              severity="secondary"
              size="small"
              rounded
              (onClick)="volver()"
            />
            <p-button type="submit" label="Guardar" icon="pi pi-check" rounded size="small" [loading]="guardando()" />

      </div>

      <!-- ═══════════════ COLUMNA DERECHA ═══════════════ -->
      <div class="producto-col-der">
        <!-- Imágenes -->
        <div class="card mb-3">
          <div class="img-header">
            <div>
              <h3 class="card-title">Imágenes del Producto</h3>
              <p class="card-hint">Máximo {{ MAX_IMAGENES }} imágenes. Formato JPG/PNG.</p>

              <p-button
                size="small"
                icon="pi pi-plus"
                label="Agregar"
                severity="success"
                variant="text"
                [rounded]="true"
                (click)="fileInput.click()"
              />
            }
          </div>
          <input
            #fileInput
            type="file"
            accept="image/*"
            hidden
            (change)="onSeleccionarImagen($event, imagenesCount)"
          />

          @if (imagenes().length > 0) {
            <p-galleria
              [(value)]="imagenes"
              [activeIndex]="activeIndex()"
              (onActiveIndexChange)="activeIndex.set($event)"
              [showThumbnails]="true"
              [showItemNavigators]="true"
              [circular]="true"
              [numVisible]="5"
              [thumbnailsPosition]="'left'"
              [containerStyle]="{ 'max-width': '98%' }"
              styleClass="producto-galleria"
            >
              <ng-template #item let-item>
                <div class="galleria-item">
                  <img [src]="getImagenUrl(item)" style="width: 100%; display: block" />
                </div>
              </ng-template>
              <ng-template #thumbnail let-item>
                <div class="galleria-thumb">
                  <img [src]="getImagenUrl(item)" />
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    class="galleria-thumb-remove"
                    (click)="eliminarImagen(item); $event.stopPropagation()"
                    pTooltip="Eliminar"
                  >
                    <i class="pi pi-times"></i>
                  </button>
                </div>
              </ng-template>
            </p-galleria>
          } @else {
            <div class="img-empty-state" (click)="fileInput.click()">
              <i class="pi pi-images"></i>
              <span>Sin imágenes — clic para agregar</span>
            </div>
          }
        </div>

        <!-- Fieldset: Información Específica -->
        <div class="fieldset-wrapper">
        <p-fieldset legend="Información Específica" styleClass="mb-3"   [toggleable]="true">
          <!-- Formulario de atributo -->
          <div class="atributo-form" [formGroup]="atributoForm">
            <div class="p-fluid">
              <div class="form-grid-3">
                <div class="campo">
                  <label>Tipo <span class="req">*</span></label>
                  <p-select
                    size="small"
                    formControlName="tipo"
                    [options]="TIPOS_OPTIONS"
                    optionLabel="label"
                    optionValue="value"
                    placeholder="Seleccione tipo"
                    styleClass="w-full"
                    [appendTo]="'body'"
                    [ngClass]="{ 'ng-invalid': invalidAtributo('tipo') }"
                  />
                </div>

                <div class="campo">
                  <label>Descripción <span class="req">*</span></label>
                  <input
                    pInputText
                    pSize="small"
                    formControlName="descripcion"
                    maxlength="30"
                    placeholder="Descripción"
                    [ngClass]="{ 'ng-invalid': invalidAtributo('descripcion') }"
                  />
                </div>

                <div class="campo">
                  <label>Estado</label>
                  <p-select
                    size="small"
                    formControlName="sn_activo"
                    [options]="snOptions"
                    optionLabel="label"
                    optionValue="value"
                    placeholder="Estado"
                    styleClass="w-full"
                    [appendTo]="'body'"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div class="atributo-acciones">
                <p-button
                  size="small"
                  label="Limpiar"
                  icon="pi pi-times"
                  severity="secondary"
                  variant="text"
                  [rounded]="true"
                  (onClick)="cancelarAtributo()"
                />
                <p-button
                  size="small"
                  [label]="atributoEditando() ? 'Actualizar' : 'Agregar'"
                  [icon]="atributoEditando() ? 'pi pi-check' : 'pi pi-plus'"
                  severity="success"
                  variant="text"
                  [raised]="true"
                  [rounded]="true"
                  [loading]="guardandoAtributo()"
                  (onClick)="guardarAtributo()"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- Tabla de atributos -->
          @if (atributos().length > 0) {
            <p-table
              id="gridinfoadd"
              [value]="atributos()"
              size="small"
              [paginator]="true"
              [rows]="5"
              [rowsPerPageOptions]="[5, 10, 25]"
              [showCurrentPageReport]="true"
              currentPageReportTemplate="Mostrando {first} a {last} de {totalRecords}"
            >
              <ng-template pTemplate="header">
                <tr>
                  <th style="width: 30%">Tipo</th>
                  <th>Descripción</th>
                  <th style="width: 15%">Estado</th>
                  <th style="width: 15%">Acciones</th>
                </tr>
              </ng-template>
              <ng-template pTemplate="body" let-attr>
                <tr>
                  <td>
                    <span>{{ getTipoLabel(attr.tipo) }}</span>
                  </td>
                  <td>{{ attr.descripcion }}</td>
                  <td>
                    @if (attr.sn_activo === 'S') {

                      <p-badge value="Activo" severity="success" badgeSize="small" />
                    } @else {
                      <p-badge value="Inactivo"  severity="warn" badgeSize="small" />
                    }
                  </td>
                  <td>
                    <div class="d-flex gap-1">
                      <p-button
                        size="small"
                        icon="pi pi-pencil"
                        severity="warn"
                        variant="text"
                        [rounded]="true"
                        pTooltip="Editar"
                        (onClick)="editarAtributo(attr)"
                      />
                      <p-button
                        size="small"
                        icon="pi pi-trash"
                        severity="danger"
                        variant="text"
                        [rounded]="true"
                        pTooltip="Eliminar"
                        (onClick)="eliminarAtributo(attr)"
                      />
                    </div>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              </ng-template>
            </p-table>
          } @else {
            <p class="text-muted text-center">Sin atributos registrados</p>
          }
        </p-fieldset>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  }
</section>
```

```typescript
/* ═══════════════ Layout principal ═══════════════ */
.producto-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 45% 55%;
  gap: 1.25rem;
  align-items: start;

  @media (max-width: 960px) {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

.producto-col-izq {
  min-width: 0;
}

.producto-col-der {
  position: sticky;
  top: 5rem;

  @media (max-width: 960px) {
    position: static;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════ Cards ═══════════════ */
.card {
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: 0.75rem;
  padding: 1.25rem;
}

.card-title {
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--c-text);
  margin: 0 0 0.25rem;
}

.card-hint {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  margin: 0 0 1rem;
}

.mb-3 {
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

/* ═══════════════ Campos ═══════════════ */
.campo {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.3rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
  width: 90%;

  label {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--color-texto-label);
  }

  .req {
    color: #ef4444;
  }

  .err {
    color: #ef4444;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
  }

  ::ng-deep {
    .p-select {
      width: 100%;
    }

    .p-inputnumber {
      width: 100%;
    }
  }
}

/* ═══════════════ Grid 2 columnas dentro de accordion ═══════════════ */
.form-grid-2 {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 0.75rem 1.25rem;

  @media (max-width: 640px) {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════ Acciones ═══════════════ */
.acciones-form {

  justify-content: flex-end;

  padding-top: 1rem;

.badge-inactivo {

  padding: 0.15rem 0.5rem;
  border-radius: 0.375rem;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  background: #fee2e2;
  color: #991b1b;
}

.d-flex {
  display: flex;
}

.gap-1 {
  gap: 0.25rem;
}

.text-center {
  text-align: center;
}

.text-muted {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);

}

/* ═══════════════ Fieldset wrapper ═══════════════ */
.fieldset-wrapper {
  width: 98%;
}

/* ═══════════════ PrimeNG Fieldset override ═══════════════ */
::ng-deep .p-fieldset {
  .p-fieldset-legend {
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;

/* ═══════════════ PrimeNG Table en fieldset ═══════════════ */
::ng-deep .p-fieldset .p-datatable {

/* ═══════════════ Imágenes ═══════════════ */
.img-header {

.img-empty-state {

  border: 2px dashed var(--c-border);
  border-radius: 0.5rem;
  background: var(--c-surface-ground);
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: border-color 0.2s, background 0.2s;

  i {
    font-size: 2rem;

  span {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
  }

  &:hover {
    border-color: var(--c-primary);
    background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.05);

}

/* ═══════════════ PrimeNG Accordion override ═══════════════ */
::ng-deep .p-accordion {
  .p-accordion-header {
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-weight: 600;
  }

  .p-accordion-content {
    padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════ Galleria ═══════════════ */
::ng-deep .producto-galleria {
  .p-galleria-content {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: row;
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }

  .p-galleria-thumbnail-wrapper {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
  }

  .p-galleria-indicator-list {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
  }
}

.galleria-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  background: var(--c-surface-ground);
  border-radius: 0.5rem;
  overflow: hidden;

  img {
    max-height: 400px;
    object-fit: contain;
  }
}

.galleria-thumb {
  position: relative;
  width: 60px;
  height: 60px;
  border-radius: 0.375rem;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 2px solid transparent;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: border-color 0.2s;

  img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
  }

  &:hover {
    border-color: var(--c-primary);
  }
}

.galleria-thumb-remove {
  position: absolute;
  top: 2px;
  right: 2px;
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.9);
  color: white;
  border: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 0.6rem;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.2s;

  &:hover {
    background: #dc2626;
  }
}

.galleria-thumb:hover .galleria-thumb-remove {
  opacity: 1;
}
```
