## 📄 src\app\features\planilla\empleados\empleado-form.ts

```typescript
import { Component, inject, signal, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { ReactiveFormsModule, FormBuilder, FormGroup, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';
import { InputNumberModule } from 'primeng/inputnumber';
import { SelectModule } from 'primeng/select';
import { SelectButtonModule } from 'primeng/selectbutton';
import { DatePickerModule } from 'primeng/datepicker';
import { MessageService } from 'primeng/api';
import { PlanillaService } from '../../../core/services/planilla.service';
import { ApiService } from '../../../core/services/api.service';
import { AuthService } from '../../../core/services/auth.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-empleado-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    CommonModule,
    ReactiveFormsModule,
    ButtonModule,
    InputTextModule,
    InputNumberModule,
    SelectModule,
    SelectButtonModule,
    DatePickerModule,
  ],
  templateUrl: './empleado-form.html',
  styleUrl: './empleado-form.scss',
})
export class EmpleadoForm implements OnInit {
  private fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private router = inject(Router);
  private service = inject(PlanillaService);
  private api = inject(ApiService);
  private auth = inject(AuthService);
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);

  esEdicion = signal(false);
  cargando = signal(false);
  guardando = signal(false);
  titulo = signal('Nuevo empleado');

  paises = signal<{ label: string; value: any }[]>([]);
  profesiones = signal<{ label: string; value: any }[]>([]);
  puestos = signal<{ label: string; value: any }[]>([]);

  readonly snOptions = [
    { label: 'Activo', value: 'S' },
    { label: 'Inactivo', value: 'N' },
  ];

  readonly sexoOptions = [
    { label: 'Masculino', value: 'M' },
    { label: 'Femenino', value: 'F' },
    { label: 'Otro', value: 'T' },
  ];

  readonly estadoCivilOptions = [
    { label: 'Soltero', value: 'S' },
    { label: 'Casado', value: 'C' },
    { label: 'Viudo', value: 'V' },
    { label: 'Divorciado', value: 'D' },
    { label: 'Unión libre', value: 'U' },
  ];

  private empleadoId = 0;

  form!: FormGroup;

  ngOnInit() {
    this.form = this.fb.group({
      nombres: ['', Validators.required],
      apellidos: ['', Validators.required],
      dni: ['', Validators.required],
      fechanacimiento: [null as Date | null],
      sexo: ['M' as 'M' | 'F' | 'T'],
      estadocivil: ['S' as 'S' | 'C' | 'V' | 'D' | 'U'],
      paisorigen: [null as number | null],
      paisresidencia: [null as number | null],
      nroseguro: [''],
      telefono: [''],
      celular: [''],
      email: [''],
      profesionId: [null as number | null],
      puestoId: [null as number | null],
      sueldobruto: [0],
      techoseguro: [0],
      cuentabancaria: [''],
      lugardenacimiento: [''],
      tipoempId: [0, Validators.required],
      sn_activo: ['S' as 'S' | 'N'],
    });

    this.cargarOpciones();

    const id = this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id');
    if (id) {
      this.esEdicion.set(true);
      this.titulo.set('Editar empleado');
      this.empleadoId = Number(id);
      this.cargando.set(true);
      this.service.getEmpleado(this.empleadoId).subscribe({
        next: (e) => {
          this.form.patchValue({
            nombres: e.nombres,
            apellidos: e.apellidos,
            dni: e.dni,
            fechanacimiento: e.fechanacimiento ? new Date(e.fechanacimiento) : null,
            sexo: e.sexo,
            estadocivil: e.estadocivil,
            paisorigen: e.paisorigen,
            paisresidencia: e.paisresidencia,
            nroseguro: e.nroseguro,
            telefono: e.telefono,
            celular: e.celular,
            email: e.email,
            profesionId: e.profesionId,
            puestoId: e.puestoId,
            sueldobruto: Number(e.sueldobruto),
            techoseguro: Number(e.techoseguro),
            cuentabancaria: e.cuentabancaria,
            lugardenacimiento: e.lugardenacimiento,
            tipoempId: e.tipoempId,
            sn_activo: e.sn_activo === 'S' ? 'S' : 'N',
          });
          this.cargando.set(false);
        },
        error: () => {
          this.cargando.set(false);
          this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: 'Empleado no encontrado' });
          this.volver();
        },
      });
    }
  }

  private cargarOpciones() {
    this.api.get<any[]>('/parametros/paises').subscribe((items) => {
      this.paises.set((items ?? []).map((i) => ({ label: String(i.descripcion ?? i.paisId), value: i.paisId })));
    });
    this.api.get<any[]>('/planilla/profesiones').subscribe((items) => {
      this.profesiones.set((items ?? []).map((i) => ({ label: String(i.descripcion), value: i.profesionId })));
    });
    this.api.get<any[]>('/planilla/puestos').subscribe((items) => {
      this.puestos.set((items ?? []).map((i) => ({ label: String(i.descripcion), value: i.puestosId })));
    });
  }

  invalid(ctrl: string): boolean {
    const c = this.form.get(ctrl);
    return !!c && c.invalid && (c.dirty || c.touched);
  }

  volver() {
    this.router.navigate(['../'], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  guardar() {
    if (this.form.invalid) {
      this.form.markAllAsTouched();
      return;
    }

    const raw = this.form.getRawValue();
    raw.paisorigen = raw.paisorigen ?? null;
    raw.paisresidencia = raw.paisresidencia ?? null;

    const payload = this.esEdicion()
      ? { ...raw }
      : {
          ...raw,
          empresaId: this.auth.currentUser()?.empresaId,
          sn_activo: 'S',
        };

    this.guardando.set(true);
    const op = this.esEdicion()
      ? this.service.updateEmpleado(this.empleadoId, payload as any)
      : this.service.createEmpleado(payload as any);

    op.subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.guardando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({
          severity: 'success',
          summary: 'Guardado',
          detail: this.esEdicion() ? 'Empleado actualizado' : 'Empleado creado correctamente',
        });
        this.volver();
      },
      error: () => {
        this.guardando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: 'No se pudo guardar el empleado' });
      },
    });
  }
}
```

## 📄 src\app\features\planilla\empleados\empleados.ts

```typescript
import { Component, inject, signal, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router, ActivatedRoute } from '@angular/router';
import { DataViewModule } from 'primeng/dataview';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';
import { TagModule } from 'primeng/tag';
import { TooltipModule } from 'primeng/tooltip';
import { MessageService } from 'primeng/api';
import { PlanillaService } from '../../../core/services/planilla.service';
import { PlanillaEmpleado } from '../../../core/models/planilla.models';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-empleados',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    CommonModule,
    FormsModule,
    DataViewModule,
    ButtonModule,
    InputTextModule,
    TagModule,
    TooltipModule,
  ],
  templateUrl: './empleados.html',
  styleUrl: './empleados.scss',
})
export class Empleados implements OnInit {
  private service = inject(PlanillaService);
  private router = inject(Router);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);

  data = signal<PlanillaEmpleado[]>([]);
  filtered = signal<PlanillaEmpleado[]>([]);
  cargando = signal(false);

  q = signal('');

  ngOnInit() {
    this.load();
  }

  load() {
    this.cargando.set(true);
    this.service.getEmpleados().subscribe({
      next: (res) => {
        this.data.set(res);
        this.filtrar();
        this.cargando.set(false);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.cargando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: 'No se pudieron cargar los empleados' });
      },
    });
  }

  filtrar() {
    const q = this.q().toLowerCase();
    this.filtered.set(
      this.data().filter((e) => {
        if (!q) return true;
        return (
          e.nombres?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          e.apellidos?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          e.dni?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          e.telefono?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          e.email?.toLowerCase().includes(q)
        );
      }),
    );
  }

  buscar() {
    this.filtrar();
  }

  limpiarFiltros() {
    this.q.set('');
    this.filtrar();
  }

  nuevo() {
    this.router.navigate(['nuevo'], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  editar(id: number) {
    this.router.navigate(['editar', id], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  activoLbl(sn: string): string {
    return sn === 'S' ? 'Activo' : 'Inactivo';
  }

  activoSev(sn: string): 'success' | 'danger' {
    return sn === 'S' ? 'success' : 'danger';
  }
}
```

## 📄 src\app\features\planilla\planilla.routes.ts

```typescript
import { Routes } from '@angular/router';

export const PLANILLA_ROUTES: Routes = [
  { path: '', redirectTo: 'empleados', pathMatch: 'full' },

  // Empleados (CRUD dedicado)
  {
    path: 'empleados',
    loadComponent: () =>
      import('./empleados/empleados').then((m) => m.Empleados),
  },
  {
    path: 'empleados/nuevo',
    loadComponent: () =>
      import('./empleados/empleado-form').then((m) => m.EmpleadoForm),
  },
  {
    path: 'empleados/editar/:id',
    loadComponent: () =>
      import('./empleados/empleado-form').then((m) => m.EmpleadoForm),
  },

  // Catálogos genéricos
  { path: 'puestos', data: { nombre: 'puestos' }, loadComponent: () => import('../parametros/catalogo-generico/catalogo-generico').then((m) => m.CatalogoGenerico) },
  { path: 'puestos/editar/:id', data: { nombre: 'puestos' }, loadComponent: () => import('../parametros/catalogo-generico/catalogo-form').then((m) => m.CatalogoForm) },
  { path: 'profesiones', data: { nombre: 'profesiones' }, loadComponent: () => import('../parametros/catalogo-generico/catalogo-generico').then((m) => m.CatalogoGenerico) },
  { path: 'profesiones/editar/:id', data: { nombre: 'profesiones' }, loadComponent: () => import('../parametros/catalogo-generico/catalogo-form').then((m) => m.CatalogoForm) },
  { path: 'deducciones', data: { nombre: 'deducciones' }, loadComponent: () => import('../parametros/catalogo-generico/catalogo-generico').then((m) => m.CatalogoGenerico) },
  { path: 'deducciones/editar/:id', data: { nombre: 'deducciones' }, loadComponent: () => import('../parametros/catalogo-generico/catalogo-form').then((m) => m.CatalogoForm) },
  { path: 'ingresos', data: { nombre: 'ingresos' }, loadComponent: () => import('../parametros/catalogo-generico/catalogo-generico').then((m) => m.CatalogoGenerico) },
  { path: 'ingresos/editar/:id', data: { nombre: 'ingresos' }, loadComponent: () => import('../parametros/catalogo-generico/catalogo-form').then((m) => m.CatalogoForm) },
```

## 📄 src\app\features\usuarios\lista-usuarios\lista-usuarios.ts

```typescript
import { Component, inject, signal, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router, ActivatedRoute } from '@angular/router';
import { DataViewModule } from 'primeng/dataview';
import { TableModule } from 'primeng/table';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';
import { SelectModule } from 'primeng/select';
import { TagModule } from 'primeng/tag';
import { TooltipModule } from 'primeng/tooltip';
import { MessageService } from 'primeng/api';
import { UsuariosService } from '../../../core/services/usuarios.service';
import { Usuario } from '../../../core/models/usuario.models';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-lista-usuarios',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    CommonModule,
    FormsModule,
    DataViewModule,
    TableModule,
    ButtonModule,
    InputTextModule,
    SelectModule,
    TagModule,
    TooltipModule,
  ],
  templateUrl: './lista-usuarios.html',
  styleUrl: './lista-usuarios.scss',
})
export class ListaUsuarios implements OnInit {
  private service = inject(UsuariosService);
  private router = inject(Router);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);

  data = signal<Usuario[]>([]);
  filtered = signal<Usuario[]>([]);
  cargando = signal(false);

  q = signal('');
  estadoFiltro = signal<string | null>(null);

  readonly estadoOptions = [
    { label: 'Todos', value: null },
    { label: 'Activo', value: 'S' },
    { label: 'Inactivo', value: 'N' },
  ];

  ngOnInit() {
    this.load();
  }

  load() {
    this.cargando.set(true);
    this.service.getAll().subscribe({
      next: (res) => {
        this.data.set(res);
        this.filtrar();
        this.cargando.set(false);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.cargando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({
          severity: 'error',
          summary: 'Error',
          detail: 'No se pudieron cargar los usuarios',
        });
      },
    });
  }

  filtrar() {
    const q = this.q().toLowerCase();
    const est = this.estadoFiltro();
    this.filtered.set(
      this.data().filter((u) => {
        const matchQ =
          !q ||
          u.usuario.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (u.nombre?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ?? false) ||
          (u.email?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ?? false);
        const matchEst = !est || u.sn_activo === est;
        return matchQ && matchEst;
      }),
    );
  }

  buscar() {
    this.filtrar();
  }

  limpiarFiltros() {
    this.q.set('');
    this.estadoFiltro.set(null);
    this.filtrar();
  }

  nuevo() {
    this.router.navigate(['nuevo'], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  editar(usuario: string, e?: Event) {
    e?.stopPropagation();
    this.router.navigate(['editar', usuario], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  activoLbl(sn: string): string {
    return sn === 'S' ? 'Activo' : 'Inactivo';
  }

  activoSev(sn: string): 'success' | 'danger' {
    return sn === 'S' ? 'success' : 'danger';
  }
}
```

```typescript
<section class="page">
  <header class="page-header">
    <div>
      <h1 class="page-title">{{ titulo() }}</h1>
      <p class="page-subtitle">Registro de usuario del sistema</p>
    </div>
    <p-button
      label="Volver"
      icon="pi pi-arrow-left"
      severity="secondary"
      text
      size="small"
      rounded
      (onClick)="volver()"
    />
  </header>

  @if (cargando()) {
    <div class="card">Cargando datos...</div>
  } @else {
    <form [formGroup]="form" (ngSubmit)="guardar()" class="card form-grid">
      <div class="campo">
        <label for="usuario">Usuario <span class="req">*</span></label>
        <input
          pInputText
          id="usuario"
          formControlName="usuario"
          maxlength="12"
          placeholder="Nombre de acceso"
          autocomplete="off"
          [readonly]="esEdicion()"
          [ngClass]="{ 'ng-invalid': invalid('usuario') }"
        />
        @if (invalid('usuario')) {
          <small class="err">El usuario es obligatorio</small>
        }
      </div>

      <div class="campo">
        <label for="nombre">Nombre <span class="req">*</span></label>
        <input
          pInputText
          id="nombre"
          formControlName="nombre"
          maxlength="80"
          placeholder="Nombre completo"
          [ngClass]="{ 'ng-invalid': invalid('nombre') }"
        />
        @if (invalid('nombre')) {
          <small class="err">El nombre es obligatorio</small>
        }
      </div>

      <div class="campo">
        <label for="email">Email <span class="req">*</span></label>
        <input
          pInputText
          id="email"
          formControlName="email"
          maxlength="20"
          type="email"
          placeholder="correo@empresa.com"
          [ngClass]="{ 'ng-invalid': invalid('email') }"
        />
        @if (invalid('email')) {
          <small class="err">Ingrese un email válido</small>
        }
      </div>

      <div class="campo">
        <label for="empresaId">Empresa <span class="req">*</span></label>
        <p-select
size="small"           id="empresaId"
          formControlName="empresaId"
          [options]="empresas()"
          optionLabel="descripcion"
          optionValue="empresaId"
          placeholder="Seleccione empresa"
          [fluid]="true"
          [showClear]="true"
          [disabled]="esEdicion()"
          [loading]="empresasCargando()"
          (onChange)="onEmpresaChange($event)"
          [ngClass]="{ 'ng-invalid': invalid('empresaId') }"
        />
        @if (invalid('empresaId')) {
          <small class="err">Seleccione una empresa</small>
        }
      </div>

      <div class="campo">
        <label for="Idsucursal">Sucursal <span class="req">*</span></label>
        <p-select
size="small"           id="Idsucursal"
          formControlName="Idsucursal"
          [options]="sucursales()"
          optionLabel="descripcion"
          optionValue="idsucursal"
          placeholder="Seleccione sucursal"
          [fluid]="true"
          [showClear]="true"
          [loading]="sucursalesCargando()"
          [ngClass]="{ 'ng-invalid': invalid('Idsucursal') }"
        />
        @if (invalid('Idsucursal')) {
          <small class="err">Seleccione una sucursal</small>
        }
        @if (esEdicion() && sucursales().length === 0 && !sucursalesCargando()) {
          <small class="hint">La empresa no tiene sucursales activas</small>
        }
      </div>

      <div class="campo">
        <label for="password">
          {{ esEdicion() ? 'Nueva contraseña' : 'Contraseña' }}
          @if (!esEdicion()) {
            <span class="req">*</span>
          }
        </label>
        <p-password
          id="password"
          formControlName="password"
          [toggleMask]="true"
          [feedback]="false"
          autocomplete="new-password"
          [fluid]="true"
          [ngClass]="{ 'ng-invalid': invalid('password') || !!errorPassword() }"
        />
        @if (esEdicion()) {
          <small class="hint">Dejar vacío para mantener la actual</small>
        }
        @if (invalid('password')) {
          <small class="err">La contraseña es requerida</small>
        }
        @if (errorPassword() && !invalid('password')) {
          <small class="err">{{ errorPassword() }}</small>
        }
      </div>

      @if (esEdicion()) {
        <div class="campo">
          <label>Estado <span class="req">*</span></label>
          <p-selectbutton size="small"
            [options]="snOptions"
            formControlName="sn_activo"
            optionLabel="label"
            optionValue="value"
          />
        </div>
      }

      <div class="acciones-form">
        <p-button
          type="button"
          label="Cancelar"
          icon="pi pi-times"
          severity="secondary"
          size="small"
          rounded
          (onClick)="volver()"
        />
        <p-button type="submit" label="Guardar" icon="pi pi-check" rounded size="small" [loading]="guardando()" />
      </div>
    </form>
  }
</section>
```

## 📄 src\app\features\usuarios\lista-usuarios\usuario-form.ts

```typescript
﻿import { Component, inject, signal, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { ReactiveFormsModule, FormBuilder, FormGroup, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';
import { PasswordModule } from 'primeng/password';
import { SelectButtonModule } from 'primeng/selectbutton';
import { SelectModule } from 'primeng/select';
import { MessageService } from 'primeng/api';
import { UsuariosService } from '../../../core/services/usuarios.service';
import { EmpresasService } from '../../../core/services/empresas.service';
import { SucursalesService } from '../../../core/services/sucursales.service';
import { AuthService } from '../../../core/services/auth.service';
import { Empresa } from '../../../core/models/empresa.models';
import { Sucursal } from '../../../core/models/sucursal.models';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-usuario-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    CommonModule,
    ReactiveFormsModule,
    ButtonModule,
    InputTextModule,
    PasswordModule,
    SelectButtonModule,
    SelectModule,
  ],
  templateUrl: './usuario-form.html',
  styleUrl: './usuario-form.scss',
})
export class UsuarioForm implements OnInit {
  private fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private router = inject(Router);
  private service = inject(UsuariosService);
  private empresasSvc = inject(EmpresasService);
  private sucursalesSvc = inject(SucursalesService);
  private auth = inject(AuthService);
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);

  esEdicion = signal(false);
  cargando = signal(false);
  guardando = signal(false);
  titulo = signal('Nuevo usuario');
  errorPassword = signal('');
  empresas = signal<Empresa[]>([]);
  sucursales = signal<Sucursal[]>([]);
  empresasCargando = signal(false);
  sucursalesCargando = signal(false);

  readonly snOptions = [
    { label: 'Activo', value: 'S' },
    { label: 'Inactivo', value: 'N' },
  ];

  private usuarioId = '';

  form!: FormGroup;

  ngOnInit() {
    this.form = this.fb.group({
      usuario: ['', Validators.required],
      nombre: ['', Validators.required],
      email: ['', [Validators.required, Validators.email]],
      password: [''],
      sn_activo: ['S' as 'S' | 'N'],
      empresaId: [null as number | null, Validators.required],
      Idsucursal: [null as number | null, Validators.required],
    });

    this.cargarEmpresas();

    const id = this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id');
    if (id) {
      this.esEdicion.set(true);
      this.titulo.set('Editar usuario');
      this.usuarioId = id;
      this.cargando.set(true);
      this.service.getOne(id).subscribe({
        next: (u) => {
          this.form.patchValue({
            usuario: u.usuario,
            nombre: u.nombre,
            email: u.email,
            sn_activo: u.sn_activo,
            empresaId: u.empresaId,
          });
          this.cargarSucursales(u.empresaId, u.Idsucursal);
          this.cargando.set(false);
        },
        error: () => {
          this.cargando.set(false);
          this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: 'Usuario no encontrado' });
          this.volver();
        },
      });
    } else {
      const empresaId = this.auth.currentUser()?.empresaId;
      if (empresaId) {
        this.form.get('empresaId')?.setValue(empresaId);
        this.cargarSucursales(empresaId);
      }
    }
  }

  private cargarEmpresas() {
    this.empresasCargando.set(true);
    this.empresasSvc.getAll().subscribe({
      next: (list) => {
        const actual = this.auth.currentUser()?.empresaId;
        this.empresas.set(list.filter((e) => e.sn_activo === 'S' || e.empresaId === actual));
        this.empresasCargando.set(false);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.empresasCargando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: 'No se pudieron cargar las empresas' });
      },
    });
  }

  private cargarSucursales(empresaId: number, seleccionarId?: number) {
    this.sucursalesCargando.set(true);
    this.sucursalesSvc.getAll(empresaId).subscribe({
      next: (list) => {
        this.sucursales.set(list.filter((s) => s.sn_activo === 'S'));
        if (seleccionarId !== undefined) {
          this.form.get('Idsucursal')?.patchValue(seleccionarId);
        }
        this.sucursalesCargando.set(false);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.sucursales.set([]);
        this.sucursalesCargando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: 'No se pudieron cargar las sucursales' });
      },
    });
  }

  onEmpresaChange(event: { value: number }) {
    this.form.get('Idsucursal')?.reset();
    if (event.value) {
      this.cargarSucursales(event.value);
    }
  }

  invalid(ctrl: string): boolean {
    const c = this.form.get(ctrl);
    return !!c && c.invalid && (c.dirty || c.touched);
  }

  volver() {
    this.router.navigate(['../'], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  validarPassword(pw: string): boolean {
    if (!pw && !this.esEdicion()) {
      this.form.get('password')?.setErrors({ required: true });
      this.errorPassword.set('');
      return false;
    }
    if (!pw) {
      this.errorPassword.set('');
      return true;
    }
    if (pw.length < 8) {
      this.errorPassword.set('Debe tener al menos 8 caracteres');
      return false;
    }
    if (!/[A-Z]/.test(pw)) {
      this.errorPassword.set('Debe contener una letra mayúscula');
      return false;
    }
    if (!/[!@#$%^&*(),.?":{}|<>_\-+=\[\]\\;'/]/.test(pw)) {
      this.errorPassword.set('Debe contener un carácter especial');
      return false;
    }
    this.errorPassword.set('');
    return true;
  }

  guardar() {
    if (this.form.invalid) {
      this.form.markAllAsTouched();
      return;
    }

    const raw = this.form.getRawValue();
    if (!this.validarPassword(raw.password || '')) return;

    this.guardando.set(true);

    if (this.esEdicion()) {
      const dto: Record<string, unknown> = {
        nombre: raw.nombre,
        email: raw.email,
        sn_activo: raw.sn_activo,
        Idsucursal: raw.Idsucursal,
      };
      if (raw.password) {
        dto['password'] = raw.password;
      }
      this.service.update(this.usuarioId, dto as any).subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.guardando.set(false);
          this.msgs.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Guardado', detail: 'Usuario actualizado' });
          this.volver();
        },
        error: () => {
          this.guardando.set(false);
          this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: 'No se pudo guardar el usuario' });
        },
      });
    } else {
      this.service
        .create({
          usuario: raw.usuario,
          nombre: raw.nombre,
          email: raw.email,
          password: raw.password,
          empresaId: raw.empresaId,
          Idsucursal: raw.Idsucursal,
          sn_activo: 'S',
        } as any)
        .subscribe({
          next: () => {
            this.guardando.set(false);
            this.msgs.add({ severity: 'success', summary: 'Guardado', detail: 'Usuario creado correctamente' });
            this.volver();
          },
          error: () => {
            this.guardando.set(false);
```

```typescript
﻿import { Component, inject, signal, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { ReactiveFormsModule, FormBuilder, FormGroup, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';
import { SelectButtonModule } from 'primeng/selectbutton';
import { MessageService } from 'primeng/api';
import { ModulosService } from '../../../core/services/modulos.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-modulo-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, ReactiveFormsModule, ButtonModule, InputTextModule, SelectButtonModule],
  templateUrl: './modulo-form.html',
  styleUrl: './modulo-form.scss',
})
export class ModuloForm implements OnInit {
  private fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private router = inject(Router);
  private service = inject(ModulosService);
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);

  esEdicion = signal(false);
  cargando = signal(false);
  guardando = signal(false);
  titulo = signal('Nuevo módulo');

  private moduloId = 0;

  readonly snOptions = [
    { label: 'Activo', value: 'S' },
    { label: 'Inactivo', value: 'N' },
  ];

  form!: FormGroup;

  ngOnInit() {
    this.form = this.fb.group({
      descripcion: ['', Validators.required],
      sn_activo: ['S', Validators.required],
    });

    const id = this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id');
    if (id) {
      this.esEdicion.set(true);
      this.titulo.set('Editar módulo');
      this.moduloId = Number(id);
      this.cargando.set(true);
      this.service.getOne(this.moduloId).subscribe({
        next: (m) => {
          this.form.patchValue({
            descripcion: m.descripcion,
            sn_activo: m.sn_activo === 'S' ? 'S' : 'N',
          });
          this.cargando.set(false);
        },
        error: () => {
          this.cargando.set(false);
          this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: 'Módulo no encontrado' });
          this.volver();
        },
      });
    }
  }

  invalid(ctrl: string): boolean {
    const c = this.form.get(ctrl);
    return !!c && c.invalid && (c.dirty || c.touched);
  }

  volver() {
    this.router.navigate(['../'], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  guardar() {
    if (this.form.invalid) {
      this.form.markAllAsTouched();
      return;
    }

    const raw = this.form.getRawValue();
    const payload = this.esEdicion()
      ? { descripcion: raw.descripcion, sn_activo: raw.sn_activo }
      : { descripcion: raw.descripcion, sn_activo: 'S' };

    this.guardando.set(true);
    const op = this.esEdicion()
      ? this.service.update(this.moduloId, payload)
      : this.service.create(payload);

    op.subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.guardando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({
          severity: 'success',
          summary: 'Guardado',
          detail: this.esEdicion() ? 'Módulo actualizado' : 'Módulo creado correctamente',
        });
        this.volver();
      },
      error: () => {
        this.guardando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({
          severity: 'error',
          summary: 'Error',
          detail: 'No se pudo guardar el módulo',
        });
      },
    });
  }
}
```

## 📄 src\app\features\usuarios\modulos\modulos.ts

```typescript
import { Component, inject, signal, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router, ActivatedRoute } from '@angular/router';
import { DataViewModule } from 'primeng/dataview';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';
import { TagModule } from 'primeng/tag';
import { TooltipModule } from 'primeng/tooltip';
import { MessageService, ConfirmationService } from 'primeng/api';
import { ModulosService } from '../../../core/services/modulos.service';
import { Modulo } from '../../../core/models/usuario.models';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-modulos',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    CommonModule,
    FormsModule,
    DataViewModule,
    ButtonModule,
    InputTextModule,
    TagModule,
    TooltipModule,
  ],
  templateUrl: './modulos.html',
  styleUrl: './modulos.scss',
})
export class Modulos implements OnInit {
  private service = inject(ModulosService);
  private router = inject(Router);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);
  private confirm = inject(ConfirmationService);

  data = signal<Modulo[]>([]);
  filtered = signal<Modulo[]>([]);
  cargando = signal(false);

  q = signal('');

  ngOnInit() {
    this.load();
  }

  load() {
    this.cargando.set(true);
    this.service.getAll().subscribe({
      next: (res) => {
        this.data.set(res);
        this.filtrar();
        this.cargando.set(false);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.cargando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({
          severity: 'error',
          summary: 'Error',
          detail: 'No se pudieron cargar los módulos',
        });
      },
    });
  }

  filtrar() {
    const q = this.q().toLowerCase();
    this.filtered.set(
      this.data().filter((m) => {
        return !q || m.descripcion.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      }),
    );
  }

  buscar() {
    this.filtrar();
  }

  limpiarFiltros() {
    this.q.set('');
    this.filtrar();
  }

  nuevo() {
    this.router.navigate(['nuevo'], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  editar(id?: number, e?: Event) {
    e?.stopPropagation();
    if (!id) return;
    this.router.navigate(['editar', id], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  eliminar(modulo: Modulo, e?: Event) {
    e?.stopPropagation();
    this.confirm.confirm({
      message: `¿Eliminar el módulo "${modulo.descripcion}"? Esta acción no se puede deshacer.`,
      header: 'Confirmar eliminación',
      icon: 'pi pi-exclamation-triangle',
      acceptLabel: 'Sí, eliminar',
      rejectLabel: 'Cancelar',
      acceptButtonStyleClass: 'p-button-danger',
      accept: () => {
        this.service.delete(modulo.moduloId).subscribe({
          next: () => {
            this.msgs.add({
              severity: 'success',
              summary: 'Eliminado',
              detail: 'Módulo eliminado correctamente',
            });
            this.load();
          },
          error: () => {
            this.msgs.add({
              severity: 'error',
              summary: 'Error',
              detail: 'No se pudo eliminar el módulo',
            });
          },
        });
      },
    });
  }

  activoLbl(sn: string): string {
    return sn === 'S' ? 'Activo' : 'Inactivo';
  }

  activoSev(sn: string): 'success' | 'danger' {
    return sn === 'S' ? 'success' : 'danger';
  }
}
```

```typescript
﻿import { Component, inject, signal, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { ReactiveFormsModule, FormBuilder, FormGroup, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';
import { InputNumberModule } from 'primeng/inputnumber';
import { SelectModule } from 'primeng/select';
import { SelectButtonModule } from 'primeng/selectbutton';
import { MessageService } from 'primeng/api';
import { UsuariosMnuItemService } from '../../../core/services/usuarios-mnuitem.service';
import { UsuariosService } from '../../../core/services/usuarios.service';
import { ModulosService } from '../../../core/services/modulos.service';
import { AuthService } from '../../../core/services/auth.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-usuario-mnuitem-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    CommonModule,
    ReactiveFormsModule,
    ButtonModule,
    InputTextModule,
    InputNumberModule,
    SelectModule,
    SelectButtonModule,
  ],
  templateUrl: './usuario-mnuitem-form.html',
  styleUrl: './usuario-mnuitem-form.scss',
})
export class UsuarioMnuItemForm implements OnInit {
  private fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private router = inject(Router);
  private service = inject(UsuariosMnuItemService);
  private usuariosService = inject(UsuariosService);
  private modulosService = inject(ModulosService);
  private auth = inject(AuthService);
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);

  esEdicion = signal(false);
  cargando = signal(false);
  guardando = signal(false);
  titulo = signal('Nuevo menu item');

  usuarios = signal<{ usuario: string; nombre: string }[]>([]);
  modulos = signal<{ moduloId: number; descripcion: string }[]>([]);

  readonly snOptions = [
    { label: 'Activo', value: 'S' },
    { label: 'Inactivo', value: 'N' },
  ];

  private recordId = 0;

  form!: FormGroup;

  ngOnInit() {
    this.form = this.fb.group({
      usuario: ['', Validators.required],
      moduloId: [null as number | null, Validators.required],
      nameItem: ['', Validators.required],
      labelItem: ['', Validators.required],
      routerLink: [''],
      iconItem: [''],
      parentId: [0],
      levelId: [0],
      sn_activo: ['S', Validators.required],
    });

    this.usuariosService.getAll().subscribe({ next: (d) => this.usuarios.set(d) });
    this.modulosService.getAll().subscribe({ next: (d) => this.modulos.set(d) });

    const id = this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id');
    if (id) {
      this.esEdicion.set(true);
      this.titulo.set('Editar menu item');
      this.recordId = Number(id);
      this.cargando.set(true);
      this.service.getOne(this.recordId).subscribe({
        next: (r) => {
          this.form.patchValue({
            usuario: r.usuario,
            moduloId: r.moduloId,
            nameItem: r.nameItem,
            labelItem: r.labelItem,
            routerLink: r.routerLink ?? '',
            iconItem: r.iconItem ?? '',
            parentId: r.parentId,
            levelId: r.levelId,
            sn_activo: r.sn_activo === 'S' ? 'S' : 'N',
          });
          this.form.get('usuario')?.disable();
          this.form.get('moduloId')?.disable();
          this.cargando.set(false);
        },
        error: () => {
          this.cargando.set(false);
          this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: 'Item no encontrado' });
          this.volver();
        },
      });
    }
  }

  invalid(ctrl: string): boolean {
    const c = this.form.get(ctrl);
    return !!c && c.invalid && (c.dirty || c.touched);
  }

  volver() {
    this.router.navigate(['../'], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  guardar() {
    if (this.form.invalid) {
      this.form.markAllAsTouched();
      return;
    }

    const raw = this.form.getRawValue();
    const data = {
      usuario: raw.usuario,
      moduloId: raw.moduloId,
      nameItem: raw.nameItem,
      labelItem: raw.labelItem,
      routerLink: raw.routerLink,
      iconItem: raw.iconItem,
      parentId: Number(raw.parentId) || 0,
      levelId: Number(raw.levelId) || 0,
    };

    this.guardando.set(true);
    const op = this.esEdicion()
      ? this.service.update(this.recordId, data)
      : this.service.create({
          ...data,
          parent: 0,
          nameParent: '',
          empresaId: this.auth.currentUser()?.empresaId ?? 0,
          sn_activo: raw.sn_activo,
        });

    op.subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.guardando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({
          severity: 'success',
          summary: 'Guardado',
          detail: this.esEdicion() ? 'Item actualizado' : 'Item creado correctamente',
        });
        this.volver();
      },
      error: () => {
        this.guardando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({
          severity: 'error',
          summary: 'Error',
          detail: 'No se pudo guardar el item',
        });
      },
    });
  }
}
```

```typescript
﻿import { Component, inject, signal, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router, ActivatedRoute } from '@angular/router';
import { DataViewModule } from 'primeng/dataview';
import { TableModule } from 'primeng/table';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';
import { TagModule } from 'primeng/tag';
import { TooltipModule } from 'primeng/tooltip';
import { MessageService, ConfirmationService } from 'primeng/api';
import { UsuariosMnuItemService } from '../../../core/services/usuarios-mnuitem.service';
import { ModulosService } from '../../../core/services/modulos.service';
import { UsuariosMnuItem } from '../../../core/models/usuario.models';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-usuario-mnuitem',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    CommonModule,
    FormsModule,
    DataViewModule,
    TableModule,
    ButtonModule,
    InputTextModule,
    TagModule,
    TooltipModule,
  ],
  templateUrl: './usuario-mnuitem.html',
  styleUrl: './usuario-mnuitem.scss',
})
export class UsuarioMnuItem implements OnInit {
  private service = inject(UsuariosMnuItemService);
  private modulosService = inject(ModulosService);
  private router = inject(Router);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);
  private confirm = inject(ConfirmationService);

  data = signal<UsuariosMnuItem[]>([]);
  filtered = signal<UsuariosMnuItem[]>([]);
  cargando = signal(false);

  q = signal('');
  private modulosMap = new Map<number, string>();

  ngOnInit() {
    this.modulosService.getAll().subscribe({
      next: (d) => d.forEach((m) => this.modulosMap.set(m.moduloId, m.descripcion)),
    });
    this.load();
  }

  load() {
    this.cargando.set(true);
    this.service.getAll().subscribe({
      next: (res) => {
        this.data.set(res);
        this.filtrar();
        this.cargando.set(false);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.cargando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({
          severity: 'error',
          summary: 'Error',
          detail: 'No se pudieron cargar los items',
        });
      },
    });
  }

  filtrar() {
    const q = this.q().toLowerCase();
    this.filtered.set(
      this.data().filter((i) => {
        const text = [
          i.usuario,
          i.nameItem,
          i.labelItem,
          i.routerLink ?? '',
          this.getModuloName(i.moduloId),
        ]
          .join(' ')
          .toLowerCase();
        return !q || text.includes(q);
      }),
    );
  }

  buscar() {
    this.filtrar();
  }

  limpiarFiltros() {
    this.q.set('');
    this.filtrar();
  }

  nuevo() {
    this.router.navigate(['nuevo'], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  editar(id?: number, e?: Event) {
    e?.stopPropagation();
    if (!id) return;
    this.router.navigate(['editar', id], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  eliminar(item: UsuariosMnuItem, e?: Event) {
    e?.stopPropagation();
    this.confirm.confirm({
      message: `¿Eliminar el item "${item.labelItem}" (${item.usuario})? Esta acción no se puede deshacer.`,
      header: 'Confirmar eliminación',
      icon: 'pi pi-exclamation-triangle',
      acceptLabel: 'Sí, eliminar',
      rejectLabel: 'Cancelar',
      acceptButtonStyleClass: 'p-button-danger',
      accept: () => {
        this.service.delete(item.tusuariomnuitemsId).subscribe({
          next: () => {
            this.msgs.add({
              severity: 'success',
              summary: 'Eliminado',
              detail: 'Item eliminado correctamente',
            });
            this.load();
          },
          error: () => {
            this.msgs.add({
              severity: 'error',
              summary: 'Error',
              detail: 'No se pudo eliminar el item',
            });
          },
        });
      },
    });
  }

  getModuloName(id: number): string {
    return this.modulosMap.get(id) ?? `#${id}`;
  }

  activoLbl(sn: string): string {
    return sn === 'S' ? 'Activo' : 'Inactivo';
  }

  activoSev(sn: string): 'success' | 'danger' {
    return sn === 'S' ? 'success' : 'danger';
  }
}
```

```typescript
﻿import { Component, inject, signal, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { ReactiveFormsModule, FormBuilder, FormGroup, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { SelectModule } from 'primeng/select';
import { SelectButtonModule } from 'primeng/selectbutton';
import { MessageService } from 'primeng/api';
import { UsuarioModAuthService } from '../../../core/services/usuario-modauth.service';
import { UsuariosService } from '../../../core/services/usuarios.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-usuario-modauth-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, ReactiveFormsModule, ButtonModule, SelectModule, SelectButtonModule],
  templateUrl: './usuario-modauth-form.html',
  styleUrl: './usuario-modauth-form.scss',
})
export class UsuarioModAuthForm implements OnInit {
  private fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private router = inject(Router);
  private service = inject(UsuarioModAuthService);
  private usuariosService = inject(UsuariosService);
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);

  esEdicion = signal(false);
  cargando = signal(false);
  guardando = signal(false);
  titulo = signal('Nuevos permisos');

  usuarios = signal<{ usuario: string; nombre: string }[]>([]);

  private recordId = 0;

  readonly snOptions = [
    { label: 'Sí', value: 'S' },
    { label: 'No', value: 'N' },
  ];

  form!: FormGroup;

  ngOnInit() {
    this.form = this.fb.group({
      usuario: ['', Validators.required],
      sn_auth_anulaciones: ['N'],
      sn_auth_facturacion: ['N'],
      sn_auth_contabilizar: ['N'],
      sn_auth_devoluciones: ['N'],
      sn_auth_reversion: ['N'],
    });

    this.usuariosService.getAll().subscribe({ next: (d) => this.usuarios.set(d) });

    const id = this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id');
    if (id) {
      this.esEdicion.set(true);
      this.titulo.set('Editar permisos');
      this.recordId = Number(id);
      this.cargando.set(true);
      this.service.getOne(this.recordId).subscribe({
        next: (r) => {
          this.form.patchValue({
            usuario: r.usuario,
            sn_auth_anulaciones: r.sn_auth_anulaciones === 'S' ? 'S' : 'N',
            sn_auth_facturacion: r.sn_auth_facturacion === 'S' ? 'S' : 'N',
            sn_auth_contabilizar: r.sn_auth_contabilizar === 'S' ? 'S' : 'N',
            sn_auth_devoluciones: r.sn_auth_devoluciones === 'S' ? 'S' : 'N',
            sn_auth_reversion: r.sn_auth_reversion === 'S' ? 'S' : 'N',
          });
          this.form.get('usuario')?.disable();
          this.cargando.set(false);
        },
        error: () => {
          this.cargando.set(false);
          this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: 'Permisos no encontrados' });
          this.volver();
        },
      });
    }
  }

  invalid(ctrl: string): boolean {
    const c = this.form.get(ctrl);
    return !!c && c.invalid && (c.dirty || c.touched);
  }

  volver() {
    this.router.navigate(['../'], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  guardar() {
    if (this.form.invalid) {
      this.form.markAllAsTouched();
      return;
    }

    const raw = this.form.getRawValue();
    const dto = {
      usuario: raw.usuario,
      sn_auth_anulaciones: raw.sn_auth_anulaciones,
      sn_auth_facturacion: raw.sn_auth_facturacion,
      sn_auth_contabilizar: raw.sn_auth_contabilizar,
      sn_auth_devoluciones: raw.sn_auth_devoluciones,
      sn_auth_reversion: raw.sn_auth_reversion,
    };

    this.guardando.set(true);
    const op = this.esEdicion()
      ? this.service.update(this.recordId, dto)
      : this.service.create(dto);

    op.subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.guardando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({
          severity: 'success',
          summary: 'Guardado',
          detail: this.esEdicion() ? 'Permisos actualizados' : 'Permisos creados correctamente',
        });
        this.volver();
      },
      error: () => {
        this.guardando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({
          severity: 'error',
          summary: 'Error',
          detail: 'No se pudieron guardar los permisos',
        });
      },
    });
  }
}
```

```typescript
              severity: 'error',
              summary: 'Error',
              detail: 'No se pudieron eliminar los permisos',
            });
          },
        });
      },
    });
  }

  snLbl(sn: string): string {
    return sn === 'S' ? 'Sí' : 'No';
  }

  snSev(sn: string): 'success' | 'danger' {
    return sn === 'S' ? 'success' : 'danger';
  }
}
```

## 📄 src\app\features\usuarios\usuario-modulos\usuario-modulos-form.ts

```typescript
﻿import { Component, inject, signal, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { ReactiveFormsModule, FormBuilder, FormGroup, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { SelectModule } from 'primeng/select';
import { SelectButtonModule } from 'primeng/selectbutton';
import { MessageService } from 'primeng/api';
import { UsuariosModuleService } from '../../../core/services/usuarios-module.service';
import { UsuariosService } from '../../../core/services/usuarios.service';
import { ModulosService } from '../../../core/services/modulos.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-usuario-modulos-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, ReactiveFormsModule, ButtonModule, SelectModule, SelectButtonModule],
  templateUrl: './usuario-modulos-form.html',
  styleUrl: './usuario-modulos-form.scss',
})
export class UsuarioModulosForm implements OnInit {
  private fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private router = inject(Router);
  private service = inject(UsuariosModuleService);
  private usuariosService = inject(UsuariosService);
  private modulosService = inject(ModulosService);
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);

  esEdicion = signal(false);
  cargando = signal(false);
  guardando = signal(false);
  titulo = signal('Nueva asignación de módulo');

  usuarios = signal<{ usuario: string; nombre: string }[]>([]);
  modulos = signal<{ moduloId: number; descripcion: string }[]>([]);

  private recordId = 0;

  readonly snOptions = [
    { label: 'Sí', value: 'S' },
    { label: 'No', value: 'N' },
  ];

  form!: FormGroup;

  ngOnInit() {
    this.form = this.fb.group({
      usuario: ['', Validators.required],
      moduloId: [null as number | null, Validators.required],
      submnudatos: ['N'],
      submnurocesos: ['N'],
      submnueportes: ['N'],
    });

    this.usuariosService.getAll().subscribe({ next: (d) => this.usuarios.set(d) });
    this.modulosService.getAll().subscribe({ next: (d) => this.modulos.set(d) });

    const id = this.route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id');
    if (id) {
      this.esEdicion.set(true);
      this.titulo.set('Editar asignación de módulo');
      this.recordId = Number(id);
      this.cargando.set(true);
      this.service.getOne(this.recordId).subscribe({
        next: (r) => {
          this.form.patchValue({
            usuario: r.usuario,
            moduloId: r.moduloId,
            submnudatos: r.submnudatos === 'S' ? 'S' : 'N',
            submnurocesos: r.submnurocesos === 'S' ? 'S' : 'N',
            submnueportes: r.submnueportes === 'S' ? 'S' : 'N',
          });
          this.form.get('usuario')?.disable();
          this.form.get('moduloId')?.disable();
          this.cargando.set(false);
        },
        error: () => {
          this.cargando.set(false);
          this.msgs.add({ severity: 'error', summary: 'Error', detail: 'Asignación no encontrada' });
          this.volver();
        },
      });
    }
  }

  invalid(ctrl: string): boolean {
    const c = this.form.get(ctrl);
    return !!c && c.invalid && (c.dirty || c.touched);
  }

  volver() {
    this.router.navigate(['../'], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  guardar() {
    if (this.form.invalid) {
      this.form.markAllAsTouched();
      return;
    }

    const raw = this.form.getRawValue();
    const data = {
      usuario: raw.usuario,
      moduloId: raw.moduloId,
      submnudatos: raw.submnudatos,
      submnurocesos: raw.submnurocesos,
      submnueportes: raw.submnueportes,
    };

    this.guardando.set(true);
    const op = this.esEdicion()
      ? this.service.update(this.recordId, {
          submnudatos: data.submnudatos,
          submnurocesos: data.submnurocesos,
          submnueportes: data.submnueportes,
        })
      : this.service.create({ ...data, sn_activo: 'S' });

    op.subscribe({
      next: () => {
        this.guardando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({
          severity: 'success',
          summary: 'Guardado',
          detail: this.esEdicion() ? 'Asignación actualizada' : 'Asignación creada correctamente',
        });
        this.volver();
      },
      error: () => {
        this.guardando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({
          severity: 'error',
          summary: 'Error',
          detail: 'No se pudo guardar la asignación',
        });
      },
    });
  }
}
```

## 📄 src\app\features\usuarios\usuario-modulos\usuario-modulos.ts

```typescript
﻿import { Component, inject, signal, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router, ActivatedRoute } from '@angular/router';
import { DataViewModule } from 'primeng/dataview';
import { TableModule } from 'primeng/table';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';
import { TagModule } from 'primeng/tag';
import { TooltipModule } from 'primeng/tooltip';
import { MessageService, ConfirmationService } from 'primeng/api';
import { UsuariosModuleService } from '../../../core/services/usuarios-module.service';
import { ModulosService } from '../../../core/services/modulos.service';
import { UsuariosModule } from '../../../core/models/usuario.models';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-usuario-modulos',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    CommonModule,
    FormsModule,
    DataViewModule,
    TableModule,
    ButtonModule,
    InputTextModule,
    TagModule,
    TooltipModule,
  ],
  templateUrl: './usuario-modulos.html',
  styleUrl: './usuario-modulos.scss',
})
export class UsuarioModulos implements OnInit {
  private service = inject(UsuariosModuleService);
  private modulosService = inject(ModulosService);
  private router = inject(Router);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);
  private confirm = inject(ConfirmationService);

  data = signal<UsuariosModule[]>([]);
  filtered = signal<UsuariosModule[]>([]);
  cargando = signal(false);

  q = signal('');
  private modulosMap = new Map<number, string>();

  ngOnInit() {
    this.modulosService.getAll().subscribe({
      next: (d) => d.forEach((m) => this.modulosMap.set(m.moduloId, m.descripcion)),
    });
    this.load();
  }

  load() {
    this.cargando.set(true);
    this.service.getAll().subscribe({
      next: (res) => {
        this.data.set(res);
        this.filtrar();
        this.cargando.set(false);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.cargando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({
          severity: 'error',
          summary: 'Error',
          detail: 'No se pudieron cargar las asignaciones',
        });
      },
    });
  }

  filtrar() {
    const q = this.q().toLowerCase();
    this.filtered.set(
      this.data().filter((i) => {
        return (
          !q ||
          i.usuario.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          this.getModuloName(i.moduloId).toLowerCase().includes(q)
        );
      }),
    );
  }

  buscar() {
    this.filtrar();
  }

  limpiarFiltros() {
    this.q.set('');
    this.filtrar();
  }

  nuevo() {
    this.router.navigate(['nuevo'], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  editar(id?: number, e?: Event) {
    e?.stopPropagation();
    if (!id) return;
    this.router.navigate(['editar', id], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  eliminar(item: UsuariosModule, e?: Event) {
    e?.stopPropagation();
    this.confirm.confirm({
      message: `¿Eliminar la asignación del módulo "${this.getModuloName(item.moduloId)}" al usuario "${item.usuario}"?`,
      header: 'Confirmar eliminación',
      icon: 'pi pi-exclamation-triangle',
      acceptLabel: 'Sí, eliminar',
      rejectLabel: 'Cancelar',
      acceptButtonStyleClass: 'p-button-danger',
      accept: () => {
        this.service.delete(item.tusuariosmoduloId).subscribe({
          next: () => {
            this.msgs.add({
              severity: 'success',
              summary: 'Eliminado',
              detail: 'Asignación eliminada correctamente',
            });
            this.load();
          },
          error: () => {
            this.msgs.add({
              severity: 'error',
              summary: 'Error',
              detail: 'No se pudo eliminar la asignación',
            });
          },
        });
      },
    });
  }

  getModuloName(id: number): string {
    return this.modulosMap.get(id) ?? `#${id}`;
  }

  snLbl(sn: string): string {
    return sn === 'S' ? 'Sí' : 'No';
  }

  snSev(sn: string): 'success' | 'danger' {
    return sn === 'S' ? 'success' : 'danger';
  }

  activoLbl(sn: string): string {
    return sn === 'S' ? 'Activo' : 'Inactivo';
  }

  activoSev(sn: string): 'success' | 'danger' {
    return sn === 'S' ? 'success' : 'danger';
  }
}
```

```typescript
﻿import { Component, inject, signal, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { ReactiveFormsModule, FormBuilder, FormGroup, Validators } from '@angular/forms';
import { ActivatedRoute, Router } from '@angular/router';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';
import { SelectModule } from 'primeng/select';
import { MessageService } from 'primeng/api';
import { UsuariosScriptsService } from '../../../core/services/usuarios-scripts.service';
import { UsuariosService } from '../../../core/services/usuarios.service';
import { AuthService } from '../../../core/services/auth.service';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-usuario-scripts-form',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, ReactiveFormsModule, ButtonModule, InputTextModule, SelectModule],
  templateUrl: './usuario-scripts-form.html',
  styleUrl: './usuario-scripts-form.scss',
})
export class UsuarioScriptsForm implements OnInit {
  private fb = inject(FormBuilder);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private router = inject(Router);
  private service = inject(UsuariosScriptsService);
  private usuariosService = inject(UsuariosService);
  private auth = inject(AuthService);
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);

  guardando = signal(false);
  titulo = signal('Asignar Script');
  usuarios = signal<{ usuario: string; nombre: string }[]>([]);

  form!: FormGroup;

  ngOnInit() {
    this.form = this.fb.group({
      usuario: ['', Validators.required],
      script: ['', Validators.required],
    });

    this.usuariosService.getAll().subscribe({ next: (d) => this.usuarios.set(d) });
  }

  invalid(ctrl: string): boolean {
    const c = this.form.get(ctrl);
    return !!c && c.invalid && (c.dirty || c.touched);
  }

  cancel() {
    this.router.navigate(['../'], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  guardar() {
    if (this.form.invalid) {
      this.form.markAllAsTouched();
      return;
    }

    const raw = this.form.getRawValue();
    this.guardando.set(true);
    this.service
      .create({
        usuario: raw.usuario,
        script: raw.script,
        empresaId: this.auth.currentUser()?.empresaId ?? 0,
      })
      .subscribe({
        next: () => {
          this.guardando.set(false);
          this.msgs.add({
            severity: 'success',
            summary: 'Guardado',
            detail: 'Script asignado correctamente',
          });
          this.cancel();
        },
        error: () => {
          this.guardando.set(false);
          this.msgs.add({
            severity: 'error',
            summary: 'Error',
            detail: 'No se pudo asignar el script',
          });
        },
      });
  }
}
```

```typescript
    <div class="campo">
      <label>Buscar</label>
      <input
        pInputText
        type="text"
        placeholder="Usuario o script..."
        [ngModel]="q()"
        (ngModelChange)="q.set($event)"
        (keyup.enter)="buscar()"
      />
    </div>
    <div class="campo acciones">
      <p-button label="Buscar" icon="pi pi-search" size="small" (onClick)="buscar()" />
      <p-button
        label="Limpiar"
        icon="pi pi-times"
        severity="secondary"
        text
        size="small"
        (onClick)="limpiarFiltros()"
      />
    </div>
  </div>

  <p-table
    [value]="filtered()"
    [loading]="cargando()"
    dataKey="tusuarioscriptsId"
    [paginator]="true"
    [rows]="20"
    [rowsPerPageOptions]="[10, 20, 50]"
    [showCurrentPageReport]="true"
    currentPageReportTemplate="Mostrando {first} a {last} de {totalRecords}"
    size="small"
  >
    <ng-template pTemplate="header">
      <tr>
        <th>Usuario</th>
        <th>Script</th>
        <th style="width:6rem"></th>
      </tr>
    </ng-template>
    <ng-template pTemplate="body" let-s>
      <tr>
        <td class="font-bold">{{ s.usuario }}</td>
        <td>{{ s.script }}</td>
        <td>
          <p-button icon="pi pi-trash" pTooltip="Eliminar" (onClick)="eliminar(s, $event)"
            severity="danger" text size="small" rounded />
        </td>
      </tr>
    </ng-template>
    <ng-template pTemplate="emptymessage">
      <tr><td colspan="3" class="text-center p-3">No hay scripts que coincidan con los filtros.</td></tr>
    </ng-template>
  </p-table>
</section>
```

## 📄 src\app\features\usuarios\usuario-scripts\usuario-scripts.ts

```typescript
﻿import { Component, inject, signal, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { Router, ActivatedRoute } from '@angular/router';
import { DataViewModule } from 'primeng/dataview';
import { TableModule } from 'primeng/table';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { InputTextModule } from 'primeng/inputtext';
import { TooltipModule } from 'primeng/tooltip';
import { MessageService, ConfirmationService } from 'primeng/api';
import { UsuariosScriptsService } from '../../../core/services/usuarios-scripts.service';
import { UsuariosScripts } from '../../../core/models/usuario.models';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-usuario-scripts',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    CommonModule,
    FormsModule,
    DataViewModule,
    TableModule,
    ButtonModule,
    InputTextModule,
    TooltipModule,
  ],
  templateUrl: './usuario-scripts.html',
  styleUrl: './usuario-scripts.scss',
})
export class UsuarioScripts implements OnInit {
  private service = inject(UsuariosScriptsService);
  private router = inject(Router);
  private route = inject(ActivatedRoute);
  private msgs = inject(MessageService);
  private confirm = inject(ConfirmationService);

  data = signal<UsuariosScripts[]>([]);
  filtered = signal<UsuariosScripts[]>([]);
  cargando = signal(false);

  q = signal('');

  ngOnInit() {
    this.load();
  }

  load() {
    this.cargando.set(true);
    this.service.getAll().subscribe({
      next: (res) => {
        this.data.set(res);
        this.filtrar();
        this.cargando.set(false);
      },
      error: () => {
        this.cargando.set(false);
        this.msgs.add({
          severity: 'error',
          summary: 'Error',
          detail: 'No se pudieron cargar los scripts',
        });
      },
    });
  }

  filtrar() {
    const q = this.q().toLowerCase();
    this.filtered.set(
      this.data().filter((s) => {
        return (
          !q ||
          s.usuario.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          s.script.toLowerCase().includes(q)
        );
      }),
    );
  }

  buscar() {
    this.filtrar();
  }

  limpiarFiltros() {
    this.q.set('');
    this.filtrar();
  }

  nuevo() {
    this.router.navigate(['nuevo'], { relativeTo: this.route });
  }

  eliminar(item: UsuariosScripts, e?: Event) {
    e?.stopPropagation();
    this.confirm.confirm({
      message: `¿Eliminar el script "${item.script}" de "${item.usuario}"? Esta acción no se puede deshacer.`,
      header: 'Confirmar eliminación',
      icon: 'pi pi-exclamation-triangle',
      acceptLabel: 'Sí, eliminar',
      rejectLabel: 'Cancelar',
      acceptButtonStyleClass: 'p-button-danger',
      accept: () => {
        this.service.delete(item.tusuarioscriptsId).subscribe({
          next: () => {
            this.msgs.add({
              severity: 'success',
              summary: 'Eliminado',
              detail: 'Script eliminado correctamente',
            });
            this.load();
          },
          error: () => {
            this.msgs.add({
              severity: 'error',
              summary: 'Error',
              detail: 'No se pudo eliminar el script',
            });
          },
        });
      },
    });
  }
}
```

```typescript
// ===== Diamond Dark Sidebar Theme (copiado de junta-agua) =====

$sidebar-width: 320px;
$sidebar-collapsed-width: 56px;
$topbar-height: 60px;

// CSS variables estilo Diamond
:host {
  --d-sidebar-bg-color: rgba(11, 14, 23, 0.85);
  --d-sidebar-bg-color-alt: rgba(11, 14, 23, 0.85);
  --d-sidebar-border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
  --d-app-name-color: #ffffff;
  --d-menu-separator-border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  --d-menuitem-root-text-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4);
  --d-menuitem-text-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
  --d-menuitem-hover-bg: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
  --d-menuitem-active-bg: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  --d-menuitem-active-text-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
  --d-menuitem-active-route-text-color: #ffffff;
  --d-menuitem-focus-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  --p-panelmenu-panel-border-color: #1e2e3b;
}

// ===== Wrapper =====
.layout-wrapper {
  display: flex;
  min-height: 100vh;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

// ===== Sidebar =====
.sidebar {
  width: $sidebar-width;
  min-height: 100vh;
  background: var(--c-surface);
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(160%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(160%);
  border-right: var(--d-sidebar-border);
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
  transition: width 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  z-index: 100;
  overflow-x: hidden;
  overflow-y: hidden;
  user-select: none;
}

// ===== Sidebar Header =====
.sidebar-header {
  background: var(--d-sidebar-bg-color);
  height: $topbar-height;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 0 1rem 0 1.25rem;
  border-bottom: var(--d-menu-separator-border);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  gap: 0.5rem;
}

.sidebar-close-mobile {
  display: none;
  width: 2rem;
  height: 2rem;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: none;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
  cursor: pointer;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 1rem;
  flex-shrink: 0;

  &:hover {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
    color: white;
  }
}

.sidebar-pin {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 1rem;
  height: 1rem;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
  background: transparent;
  cursor: pointer;
  outline: none;
  padding: 0;
  display: none;
  transition:
    background-color 0.15s,
    transform 0.3s;

  &.visible {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
  }

  &.pinned {
    background: var(--p-primary-color, #0ea5e9);
    border-color: var(--p-primary-color, #0ea5e9);
  }
}

.sidebar-logo {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--d-app-name-color);
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;

  .sidebar-logo-img {
    margin-top:5px;
    width: 2.75rem;
    height: 2.75rem;
    min-width: 2.25rem;
    object-fit: contain;
  }
}

.sidebar-title {
   font-family: 'AstroSpace';
  font-weight: 400;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  min-width: 0;
  color: var(--color-font-sidebar);
  flex: 1;
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.2px;
}

// ===== Menu Container =====
.sidebar-menu {
  flex: 1;
  overflow-y: auto;
  overflow-x: hidden;
  padding: 0.75rem;

  // ===== User info en sidebar =====
  .sidebar-user {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    padding: 0.65rem 0.75rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    border-bottom: var(--d-menu-separator-border);

    :deep(.p-avatar) {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f97316 0%, #fb923c 100%);

      border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);

  }

    display: flex;

    display: flex;

  }

  &::-webkit-scrollbar {
    width: 6px;
  }

  &::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
    background: transparent;

  &::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
    border-radius: 3px;

    &:hover {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);

  }

  // ===== PanelMenu overrides estilo Diamond =====
  :deep(.p-panelmenu) {
    background:transparent;

  }

  :deep(.p-panelmenu-panel) {
    background: transparent;
    border: none;
    margin-bottom: 0.1rem;
  }

  :deep(.p-panelmenu-panel:not(:last-child)) {
    border-bottom: var(--d-menu-separator-border);
    padding-bottom: 0.35rem;

    background: transparent;
    border: none;
    outline: none;
  }

  :deep(.p-panelmenu-header-content) {
    background: transparent;

  }

  :deep(.p-panelmenu-header.p-panelmenu-header-active) {
    > .p-panelmenu-header-content {
      .p-panelmenu-header-icon,

        color: var(--d-menuitem-active-route-text-color);

  :deep(.p-panelmenu-content) {

    .p-panelmenu-item-link {

    &:hover {

    }

    &:focus-visible {
      box-shadow: var(--d-menuitem-focus-shadow);
    }
  }

  :deep(.p-panelmenu-header-link.p-panelmenu-item-link-active),
  :deep(.p-panelmenu-item-link.p-panelmenu-item-link-active) {
    background: var(--d-menuitem-active-bg);

    .p-panelmenu-header-icon,

  }

  :deep(.p-panelmenu-item.p-focus > .p-panelmenu-item-content) {
    background: var(--d-menuitem-active-bg);

    .p-panelmenu-submenu .p-panelmenu-item-link {
      padding-left: 3.75rem;
    }
  }
}

// ===== Main Area =====
.layout-main {
  flex: 1;
  margin-left: $sidebar-width;
  padding-top: $topbar-height;
  transition: margin-left 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-height: 100vh;
}

// ===== Topbar =====
.topbar {
  height: $topbar-height;
  background: rgba(11, 14, 23, 0.85);
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(160%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(160%);
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 0 1.5rem;
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  z-index: 50;
  gap: 1rem;
}

@media (min-width: 769px) {
  .sidebar-hidden .sidebar {
    width: 0;
    min-width: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 0;
  }

  .sidebar-hidden .layout-main {
    margin-left: 0;
  }

  .topbar {
    left: $sidebar-width;
    transition: left 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1);
  }

  .sidebar-hidden .topbar {
    left: 0;
  }
}

.topbar-left {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
}

.topbar-right {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.75rem;
}

.user-chip {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.65rem;
  padding: 0.25rem 0.25rem 0.25rem 0.9rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
  transition:
    border-color var(--tr-fast),
    box-shadow var(--tr-fast),
    background var(--tr-fast);

  &:hover {
    border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  }
}

.user-chip-info {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  line-height: 1.2;
  text-align: right;
}

.user-name {
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #ffffff;
  font-size: 0.875rem;
}

.user-role {
  text-transform: capitalize;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55);
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}

.user-avatar {
  :deep(.p-avatar) {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f97316 0%, #fb923c 100%);
    color: #fff;
    font-weight: 700;
    border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  }
}

// Botón toggle del sidebar (naranja)
.sidebar-toggle {
  :deep(.p-button) {
    color: #fb923c;

    &:hover {
      color: #ffffff;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f97316 0%, #fb923c 100%);
    }

    &:focus-visible {
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(251, 146, 60, 0.4);
    }
  }
}

.hidden-mobile {
  @media (max-width: 768px) {
    display: none;
  }
}

// Botón "Perfil" (splitbutton) sobre topbar dark
.profile-btn {
  :deep(.p-button) {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);

    &:hover {
      color: #ffffff;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    }

    &:focus-visible {
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35);
    }
  }
}

// ===== Content =====
.layout-content {
  flex: 1;
  padding: 0.5rem;
  background:#1e2e3b;
}

// ===== Mobile Responsive =====
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .sidebar {
    transform: translateY(-110%);
    visibility: hidden;
    transition:
      transform 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1),
      visibility 0.45s;
    z-index: 200;
    min-height: 100vh;
    box-shadow: 0 24px 48px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);

    .sidebar-pin {
      display: none;
    }
    .sidebar-close-mobile {
      display: flex;
    }
  }

  .sidebar-overlay {
    display: none;
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
    z-index: 199;
  }

  .sidebar-open {
    .sidebar {
      transform: translateY(0);
      visibility: visible;
    }

    .sidebar-overlay {
      display: block;
    }
  }

  .layout-main {
    margin-left: 0 !important;
  }

  .layout-content {
  padding: 0.5rem;
  }

  .sidebar-collapsed .layout-main {
    margin-left: 0;
  }

  .topbar {
    padding: 0 0.75rem;
    z-index: 201;
  }

  .sidebar-toggle {
    .p-button {
      width: 2.75rem;
      height: 2.75rem;
    }
  }
}
```

## 📄 src\app\layout\main-layout\main-layout.ts

```typescript
﻿import { Component, DestroyRef, inject, signal, computed } from '@angular/core';
import { NavigationEnd, Router, RouterOutlet } from '@angular/router';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';
import { SplitButtonModule } from 'primeng/splitbutton';
import { AvatarModule } from 'primeng/avatar';
import { PanelMenuModule } from 'primeng/panelmenu';
import { ToastModule } from 'primeng/toast';
import { ConfirmDialogModule } from 'primeng/confirmdialog';
import { TooltipModule } from 'primeng/tooltip';
import { ConfirmationService, MenuItem } from 'primeng/api';
import { AuthService } from '../../core/services/auth.service';
import { MenuConfigService } from '../../core/services/menu-config.service';
import { Drawer, DrawerModule } from 'primeng/drawer';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-main-layout',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [
    RouterOutlet,
    ButtonModule,
    AvatarModule,
    PanelMenuModule,
    ToastModule,
    ConfirmDialogModule,
    SplitButtonModule,
    TooltipModule,
    DrawerModule,
  ],
  templateUrl: './main-layout.html',
  styleUrl: './main-layout.scss',
})
export class MainLayout {
  private auth = inject(AuthService);
  private confirm = inject(ConfirmationService);
  private router = inject(Router);
  private destroyRef = inject(DestroyRef);
  private menuConfig = inject(MenuConfigService);

  mobileSidebarOpen = signal(false);
  sidebarHidden = signal(false);
  pinned = signal(false);

  visible: boolean = false;

  constructor() {
    this.destroyRef.onDestroy(() =>
      this.router.events.subscribe((event) => {
        if (event instanceof NavigationEnd && window.innerWidth <= 768) {
          this.mobileSidebarOpen.set(false);
        }
      }),
    );
  }

  readonly user = this.auth.currentUser;

  menuItems = computed<MenuItem[]>(() =>
    this.menuConfig.getMenuItems().map((item) => this.mapItem(item)),
  );

  private mapItem(item: import('../../core/services/menu-config.service').MenuItemConfig): MenuItem {
    const mi: MenuItem = { label: item.label, icon: `pi pi-${item.icon}` };
    if (item.route) mi.routerLink = [item.route];
    if (item.children?.length) {
      mi.expanded = false;
      mi.items = item.children.map((c) => this.mapItem(c));
    }
    return mi;
  }

  userMenuItems: MenuItem[] = [
    { separator: true },
    { label: 'Cerrar Sesión', icon: 'pi pi-sign-out', command: () => this.cerrarSesion() },
  ];

  toggleSidebar() {
    if (window.innerWidth <= 768) {
      this.mobileSidebarOpen.update((v) => !v);
      return;
    }
    this.sidebarHidden.update((v) => !v);
  }

  onMenuClick(event: MouseEvent) {
    if (window.innerWidth > 768) return;
    const target = event.target as HTMLElement;
    const esNavegacion = !!target.closest('a[href]');
    if (esNavegacion) {
      this.mobileSidebarOpen.set(false);
    }
  }

  togglePin() {
    this.pinned.update((v) => !v);
    if (this.pinned()) {
      this.sidebarHidden.set(false);
    }
  }

  get toggleIcon(): string {
    if (window.innerWidth <= 768) {
      return this.mobileSidebarOpen() ? 'pi pi-angle-left' : 'pi pi-bars';
    }
    return this.sidebarHidden() ? 'pi pi-angle-right' : 'pi pi-angle-left';
  }

  get initials(): string {
    const n = this.user()?.nombre || '';
    return n
      .split(' ')
      .map((w) => w[0])
      .join('')
      .toUpperCase()
      .slice(0, 2);
  }

  cerrarSesion() {
    this.confirm.confirm({
      header: 'Cerrar sesión',
      message: '¿Estás seguro de cerrar la sesión actual?',
      icon: 'pi pi-sign-out',
      acceptLabel: 'Sí, cerrar sesión',
      rejectLabel: 'Cancelar',
      acceptButtonStyleClass: 'p-button-text p-button-success p-button-rounded',
      rejectButtonStyleClass: 'p-button-text p-button-secondary p-button-rounded',
      accept: () => this.auth.logout(),
    });
  }
}
```

```typescript
@layer primeng {
}

  font-family: 'Mukta';
  src: url('/assets/fonts/Mukta/Mukta-Regular.ttf') format('truetype');
  font-weight: 400;

}

@font-face {

}

@font-face {

  src: url('/assets/fonts/Mukta/Mukta-SemiBold.ttf') format('truetype');

@font-face {
```
