}

@font-face {
  font-family: 'Mukta';
  src: url('/assets/fonts/Mukta/Mukta-ExtraBold.ttf') format('truetype');
  font-weight: 800;
  font-style: normal;
}

:root {
  --font-family: 'Mukta', sans-serif;

  /* ===== Design tokens ===== */
  --c-bg: #f1f5f9;
  --c-surface: #ffffff;
  --c-surface-muted: #f8fafc;
  --c-border: #e2e8f0;
  --c-border-strong: #cbd5e1;
  --c-text: #0f172a;
  --c-text-secondary: #475569;
  --c-text-muted: #64748b;
  --c-text-faint: #94a3b8;
  --c-primary: #1e40af;
  --c-primary-strong: #1e3a8a;
  --c-success: #059669;
  --c-warning: #d97706;
  --c-danger: #dc2626;
  --c-info: #0284c7;

  --radius-sm: 0.5rem;
  --radius-md: 0.75rem;
  --radius-lg: 1.25rem;
  --radius-full: 9999px;

  --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06);
  --shadow-md: 0 4px 12px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.07);
  --shadow-lg: 0 12px 28px -8px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.18);
  --shadow-focus: 0 0 0 3px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.2);

  --tr-fast: 150ms ease;
  --tr-base: 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  --tr-smooth: 300ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1);

  --p-button-padding-x: 0.75rem;
  --p-button-padding-y: 0.5rem;
  --p-button-font-size: 0.875rem;
  --p-inputtext-padding-x: 0.75rem;
  --p-inputtext-padding-y: 0.5rem;
  --p-inputtext-font-size: 0.875rem;
  --p-select-padding-x: 0.75rem;
  --p-select-padding-y: 0.5rem;
  --p-select-font-size: 0.875rem;
  --p-textarea-padding-x: 0.75rem;
  --p-textarea-padding-y: 0.5rem;
  --p-textarea-font-size: 0.875rem;
  --p-datepicker-padding-x: 0.75rem;
  --p-datepicker-padding-y: 0.5rem;
  --p-datepicker-font-size: 0.875rem;
  --p-inputicon-font-size: 0.875rem;
  --p-paginator-font-size: 0.875rem;
}

body {
  font-family: var(--font-family);
  color: var(--c-text);
  background: var(--c-bg);
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}

/* =====================================================
   Animaciones de entrada
   ===================================================== */
@keyframes fadeInUp {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(10px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}

@keyframes fadeIn {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
  }
}

@keyframes pulseSoft {
  0%,
  100% {
    opacity: 1;
  }
  50% {
    opacity: 0.55;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  .page > * {
    animation: fadeInUp var(--tr-smooth) both;
  }

  .page > *:nth-child(2) {
    animation-delay: 0.04s;
  }
  .page > *:nth-child(3) {
    animation-delay: 0.08s;
  }
  .page > *:nth-child(4) {
    animation-delay: 0.12s;
  }
}

/* Skeleton shimmer */
@keyframes shimmer {
  from {
    background-position: 200% 0;
  }
  to {
    background-position: -200% 0;
  }
}

.p-skeleton {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #eef2f7 25%, #e2e8f0 50%, #eef2f7 75%) !important;
  background-size: 200% 100% !important;
  animation: shimmer 1.6s infinite !important;
}

/* =====================================================
   Estilos compartidos de páginas
   ===================================================== */

.page {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1rem;
}

.page-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;

  .page-header-text {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.15rem;
  }
}

.w-full {
  width: 100%;
}

.page-title {
  font-size: 1.6rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--c-text);
  margin: 0;
  line-height: 1.2;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}

.page-subtitle {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  margin: 0;
}

/* Tarjeta genérica */
.card {
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}

// =====================================================
// Tablas responsive con scroll horizontal
// =====================================================
.p-datatable-wrapper {
  overflow-x: auto;

  table {
    min-width: max-content;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .p-datatable-wrapper {
    margin: 0 -0.75rem;
    padding: 0 0.75rem;
  }

  .p-datatable-table {
    font-size: 0.8rem;
  }

  .p-datatable-tbody > tr > td {
    padding: 0.5rem 0.4rem !important;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .p-datatable-thead > tr > th {
    padding: 0.5rem 0.4rem !important;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .p-paginator {
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    padding: 0.5rem 0 !important;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.25rem;
  }
}

// =====================================================
// Mejoras táctiles / accesibilidad
// =====================================================
@media (pointer: coarse) {
  .p-button,
  .p-inputtext,
  .p-select,
  .p-datepicker {
    min-height: 44px;
  }
}

// =====================================================
// Responsive: compartido
// =====================================================
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .page-header {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: stretch;

    > div:first-child {
      width: 100%;
    }

    > div:last-child,
    > p-button {
      display: flex;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;

      button,
      .p-button {
        flex: 1;
        min-width: 0;
      }
    }
  }

  .card {
    padding: 0.75rem;
    border-radius: 8px;
  }

  .totales-grid {
    @media (max-width: 640px) {
  .nf-totales-row {
    .nf-total-block {
      flex: 1 1 45%;
    }
  }
}
  }
}

/* Bloque de filtros */
.filtros {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  gap: 1rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;

  .campo {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.3rem;

    label {
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--c-text-secondary);
    }

    &.acciones {
      flex-direction: row;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      align-items: center;
    }
  }

  @media (max-width: 640px) {
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.75rem;

    .campo {
      width: 100%;

      input,
      p-select,
      p-button,
      .p-select,
      .p-inputtext {
        width: 100%;
      }

      &.acciones {
        flex-direction: column;

        button,
        .p-button {
          width: 100%;
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

/* Tablas */
.text-center {
  text-align: center;
}

/* =====================================================
   DataView cards (catálogos)
   ===================================================== */
.dv-cards {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.75rem;
}

.dv-card {
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.6rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  transition:
    box-shadow var(--tr-base),
    border-color var(--tr-base),
    transform var(--tr-base);

  &:hover {
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
    border-color: #bfdbfe;
    transform: translateY(-2px);
  }

  &:focus-visible {
    outline: none;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-focus);
  }

  .dv-top {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 0.75rem;

    .dv-title {
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--c-text);
    }
  }

  .dv-body {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.4rem 1.5rem;
  }

  .dv-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.35rem;
    font-size: 0.85rem;

    .dv-label {
      color: var(--c-text-faint);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .dv-value {
      color: var(--c-text-secondary);
      font-weight: 600;

      &.dv-monto {
        color: var(--c-success);
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      }
    }
  }

  .dv-actions {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    gap: 0.25rem;
    padding-top: 0.5rem;
    border-top: 1px solid #f1f5f9;
  }

  @media (max-width: 640px) {
    padding: 0.85rem 0.9rem;
  }
}

.p-dataview-content {
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  padding: 0;
}

.monto {
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  font-weight: 600;
}

/* =====================================================
   Impresión de reportes
   ===================================================== */
@media print {
  .layout-wrapper .sidebar,
  .layout-wrapper .topbar,
  .no-print,
  .filtros,
  .page-header button,
  .p-paginator {
    display: none !important;
  }

  .layout-main {
    margin-left: 0 !important;
  }

  .layout-content {
    padding: 0 !important;
    background: #fff !important;
  }

  body {
    background: #fff !important;
  }

  .card {
    border: none !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
  }

  .print-only {
    display: block !important;
  }
}

.print-only {
  display: none;
}

/* Encabezado de reporte impreso */
.print-header {
  text-align: center;
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;

  h2 {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 1.3rem;
  }
  p {
    margin: 0.2rem 0;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: #475569;
  }
}

/* Tarjetas de totales (reportes) */
.totales-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(150px, 1fr));
  gap: 0.75rem;

  .total-card {
    background: var(--c-surface-muted);
    border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    padding: 0.75rem 1rem;

    .label {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      color: var(--c-text-muted);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.03em;
    }
    .value {
      font-size: 1.25rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--c-text);
      margin-top: 0.2rem;
    }
  }
}

}

@font-face {
  font-family: 'Mukta';
  src: url('/assets/fonts/Mukta/Mukta-Bold.ttf') format('truetype');
  font-weight: 700;
  font-style: normal;
}

@font-face {
  font-family: 'Mukta';
  src: url('/assets/fonts/Mukta/Mukta-ExtraBold.ttf') format('truetype');
  font-weight: 800;
  font-style: normal;
}

@font-face {
  font-family: 'AstroSpace';
  src: url('/assets/fonts/AstroSpace/AstroSpace.ttf') format('truetype');
  font-weight: 400;
  font-style: normal;
}


@font-face {
  font-family: 'Angora';
  src: url('/assets/fonts/Angora/Angora-1G3BB.otf') format('truetype');
  font-weight: 400;
  font-style: normal;
}


:root {
  --font-family: 'Mukta', sans-serif;

  --color-font-sidebar: #dbe7f0;
  --color-texto-label: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4);
  --color-texto-input: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.808);
  --master-background: #213341;
  --texto-secundario: #2c4d6f;
  --select-row: #93b7d3;
  --for-border-color-alls: #39495b;

  /* ===== Design tokens ===== */
  --c-bg: #1e2e3b;
  --c-bg-muted: #1e2e3b00;
  --c-surface: #1e2e3b;
  --c-surface-muted: #2d3d50b4;
  --c-card-background:#08131c;
  --c-card-color-text: var(--color-texto-label);
  --c-border: #1e2e3b;
  --c-border-strong: #2c4d6f;
  --c-text: var(--color-texto-label);
  --c-text-secondary: var(--texto-secundario);
  --c-text-muted: #8aa9c9;
  --c-text-faint: #5f86ab;
  --c-disabled-color: #1f2f3a;
  --c-primary: #3d8bff;
  --c-primary-strong: #0070f2;
  --c-success: #2fd48a;
  --c-warning: #f5a623;
  --c-danger: #ff5c5c;
  --c-info: #38bdf8;
  --c-uva: #604ec7ef;
  --c-amarillo: #f5e949ef;

  --radius-sm: 0.5rem;
  --radius-md: 0.75rem;
  --radius-lg: 1.25rem;
  --radius-full: 9999px;



  --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
  --shadow-md: 0 4px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
  --shadow-lg: 0 12px 28px -8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
  --shadow-focus: 0 0 0 3px rgba(61, 139, 255, 0.35);

  --tr-fast: 150ms ease;
  --tr-base: 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  --tr-smooth: 300ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1);

  --p-button-padding-x: 0.75rem;
  --p-button-padding-y: 0.5rem;
  --p-button-font-size: 0.875rem;
  --p-inputtext-padding-x: 0.75rem;
  --p-inputtext-padding-y: 0.5rem;
  --p-inputtext-font-size: 0.875rem;
  --p-select-padding-x: 0.75rem;
  --p-select-padding-y: 0.5rem;
  --p-select-font-size: 0.875rem;
  --p-textarea-padding-x: 0.75rem;
  --p-textarea-padding-y: 0.5rem;
  --p-textarea-font-size: 0.875rem;
  --p-datepicker-padding-x: 0.75rem;
  --p-datepicker-padding-y: 0.5rem;
  --p-datepicker-font-size: 0.875rem;
  --p-inputicon-font-size: 0.875rem;
  --p-paginator-font-size: 0.875rem;

  --p-form-field-background: #213341;
  --p-form-field-border-color: #39495b;


  --p-navigation-item-color: #7f8790;
  --p-navigation-item-icon-color: #558dc6;

  --p-panelmenu-item-focus-color: #558dc6;
  --p-navigation-submenu-icon-color: #558dc6;


  --p-card-title-font-size: 1.05rem;
  --p-card-background: var(--p-form-field-background);

  --p-inputtext-color: var(--color-texto-input);
  --p-inputtext-background: #213341;
  --p-inputtext-border-color: #39495b;
  --p-inputtext-disabled-color: var(--c-text-muted);
  --p-inputtext-disabled-background: var(--c-bg);
  --p-inputtext-disabled-border-color: #2a3a4a;

  --p-togglebutton-color: var(--color-texto-input);
  ---p-togglebutton-background: var(--color-texto-input);


  // para los botones selecionados del toggle button
  --p-togglebutton-checked-color: var(--c-success);
  --p-togglebutton-content-checked-background: var(--p-inputtext-background);


  --p-togglebutton-background: var(--c-bg);
  --p-togglebutton-checked-background: var(--c-bg);

  --p-togglebutton-hover-color: var(--c-amarillo);
  --p-togglebutton-border-color: var(--c-bg);
  --p-togglebutton-checked-border-color: var(--c-bg);


  --p-select-color: var(--color-texto-input);
  --p-select-background: var(--p-form-field-background);
  --p-select-disabled-background: var(--c-bg);
  --p-select-disabled-color: var(--c-text-muted);

  --p-inputnumber-disabled-background: var(--c-bg);
  --p-datepicker-disabled-background: var(--c-bg);

  --p-toolbar-border-color: var(--for-border-color-alls);

  --p-datatable-body-cell-border-color: #25374a;
  --p-datatable-header-cell-border-color: #25374a;
  --p-datatable-header-cell-color: var(--color-texto-input);
  --p-datatable-body-cell-sm-padding: 0.275rem 0.1rem;



  --p-tag-secondary-background: var(--c-bg-muted);
  --p-tag-success-background: var(--c-bg-muted);
  --p-tag-info-background: var(--c-bg-muted);
  --p-tag-warn-background: var(--c-bg-muted);
  --p-tag-danger-background: var(--c-bg-muted);

  --p-tag-rounded-border-radius: 5px 5px 5px 5px;

 --surface-border:var(--for-border-color-alls);

}

body {
  font-family: var(--font-family);
  color: var(--c-text);
  background: var(--c-bg);
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}

label {
  color: var(--c-text);
  /* Color del texto */
}

thead th {
  color: var(--c-text);
}

tr {
  color: var(--c-text);
}


ul {
    display: block;
    list-style-type: none;
    margin-block-start: 1em;
    margin-block-end: 1em;
    padding-inline-start: 12px;
    unicode-bidi: isolate;
}


.p-inputtext {
  color: var(--c-text);
  /* Color del texto */
}

.p-select {
  color: var(--c-text);
  /* Color del texto */
}

.p-card {
  --p-card-body-padding: 0.75rem;
  /* O el valor que prefieras, ej: 10px, 0.5rem */
}


/* =====================================================
   Animaciones de entrada
   ===================================================== */
@keyframes fadeInUp {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(10px);
  }

  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}

@keyframes fadeIn {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
  }

  to {
    opacity: 1;
  }
}

@keyframes pulseSoft {

  0%,
  100% {
    opacity: 1;
  }

  50% {
    opacity: 0.55;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  .page>* {
    animation: fadeInUp var(--tr-smooth) both;
  }

  .page>*:nth-child(2) {
    animation-delay: 0.04s;
  }

  .page>*:nth-child(3) {
    animation-delay: 0.08s;
  }

  .page>*:nth-child(4) {
    animation-delay: 0.12s;
  }
}

/* Skeleton shimmer */
@keyframes shimmer {
  from {
    background-position: 200% 0;
  }

  to {
    background-position: -200% 0;
  }
}

.p-skeleton {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #eef2f7 25%, #e2e8f0 50%, #eef2f7 75%) !important;
  background-size: 200% 100% !important;
  animation: shimmer 1.6s infinite !important;
}

/* =====================================================
   Estilos compartidos de páginas
   ===================================================== */

.page {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.5rem;
}

.page-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;

  .page-header-text {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.15rem;
  }
}

.w-full {
  width: 100%;
}

.page-title {
  font-size: 1.3rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--c-text);
  margin: 0;
  line-height: 1.2;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}

.page-subtitle {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  margin: 0;
}

/* Tarjeta genérica */
.card {
  background: var(--c-bg);
  padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
   border-bottom: 1px solid var(--for-border-color-alls);

}

// =====================================================
// Tablas responsive con scroll horizontal
// =====================================================
.p-datatable-wrapper {
  overflow-x: auto;

  table {
    min-width: max-content;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .p-datatable-wrapper {
    margin: 0 -0.75rem;
    padding: 0 0.75rem;
  }

  .p-datatable-table {
    font-size: 0.8rem;
  }

  .p-datatable-tbody>tr>td {
    padding: 0.5rem 0.4rem !important;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .p-datatable-thead>tr>th {
    padding: 0.5rem 0.4rem !important;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .p-paginator {
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    padding: 0.5rem 0 !important;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.25rem;
  }
}

// =====================================================
// Mejoras táctiles / accesibilidad
// =====================================================
@media (pointer: coarse) {

  .p-button,
  .p-inputtext,
  .p-select,
  .p-datepicker {
    min-height: 44px;
  }
}

// =====================================================
// Responsive: compartido
// =====================================================
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .page-header {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: stretch;

    >div:first-child {
      width: 100%;
    }

    >div:last-child,
    >p-button {
      display: flex;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;

      button,
      .p-button {
        flex: 1;
        min-width: 0;
      }
    }
  }

  .card {
    padding: 0.75rem;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  }

  .totales-grid {
    @media (max-width: 640px) {
      .nf-totales-row {
        .nf-total-block {
          flex: 1 1 45%;
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

/* Bloque de filtros */
.filtros {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  gap: 1rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;

  .campo {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.3rem;

    label {
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--c-text-secondary);
    }

    &.acciones {
      flex-direction: row;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      align-items: center;
    }
  }

  @media (max-width: 640px) {
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.75rem;

    .campo {
      width: 100%;

      input,
      p-select,
      p-button,
      .p-select,
      .p-inputtext {
        width: 100%;
      }

      &.acciones {
        flex-direction: column;

        button,
        .p-button {
          width: 100%;
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

/* Tablas */
.text-center {
  text-align: center;
}

/* =====================================================
   DataView cards (catálogos)
   ===================================================== */
.dv-cards {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.75rem;
}

.dv-card {
  background: var(--c-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.6rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  transition:
    box-shadow var(--tr-base),
    border-color var(--tr-base),
    transform var(--tr-base);

  &:hover {
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
    border-color: #bfdbfe;
    transform: translateY(-2px);
  }

  &:focus-visible {
    outline: none;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-focus);
  }

  .dv-top {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 0.75rem;

    .dv-title {
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--c-text);
    }
  }

  .dv-body {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.4rem 1.5rem;
  }

  .dv-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.35rem;
    font-size: 0.85rem;

    .dv-label {
      color: var(--c-text-faint);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .dv-value {
      color: var(--c-text-secondary);
      font-weight: 600;

      &.dv-monto {
        color: var(--c-success);
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      }
    }
  }

  .dv-actions {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    gap: 0.25rem;
    padding-top: 0.5rem;
    border-top: 1px solid #f1f5f9;
  }

  @media (max-width: 640px) {
    padding: 0.85rem 0.9rem;
  }
}

.p-dataview-content {
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  padding: 0;
}

.monto {
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  font-weight: 600;
}

/* =====================================================
   Impresión de reportes
   ===================================================== */
@media print {

  .layout-wrapper .sidebar,
  .layout-wrapper .topbar,
  .no-print,
  .filtros,
  .page-header button,
  .p-paginator {
    display: none !important;
  }

  .layout-main {
    margin-left: 0 !important;
  }

  .layout-content {
    padding: 0 !important;
    background: #fff !important;
  }

  body {
    background: #fff !important;
  }

  .card {
    border: none !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
  }

  .print-only {
    display: block !important;
  }
}

.print-only {
  display: none;
}

/* Encabezado de reporte impreso */
.print-header {
  text-align: center;
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;

  h2 {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: 1.3rem;
  }

  p {
    margin: 0.2rem 0;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: #475569;
  }
}

/* Tarjetas de totales (reportes) */
.totales-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(150px, 1fr));
  gap: 0.75rem;

  .total-card {
    background: var(--c-surface-muted);
    border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    padding: 0.75rem 1rem;

    .label {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      color: var(--c-text-muted);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.03em;
    }

    .value {
      font-size: 1.25rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--c-text);
      margin-top: 0.2rem;
    }
  }
}
